name: noop_empty_function
what the code shows: Empty function; does nothing and returns nothing.

name: init_system_and_loop_frames_forever
what the code shows: Calls an empty function, ResetCallback and StopCallback, loops on init_cd_menu until it succeeds, then calls load_and_exec_program_by_index(0), clears scratch words and sets game_state.field_1e to 0x1c3. It then calls init_system_and_pads, init_display_buffers and init_snd_voices, and loops forever: per frame it resets the root counter, checks pads, handles reset and session-restart cases, updates the CD control, draws text items, swaps buffers, waits with DrawSync until the frame count is reached and counts data_801ac620 down.

name: init_system_and_pads
what the code shows: Calls ResetCallback, StopCallback, then loops on func_8014f0bc (CD init) until it returns nonzero. Then calls SetDispMask(0), ResetGraph(0), func_8015f734(0), stores a and b in data_801abef8 and data_801ac314, and closes sound via func_8012028c if the word at 0x1f800000 is negative. Then calls func_80120168 (sound init), InitPAD with two buffers, StartPAD, func_801542ec and ChangeClearPAD(0), clears three scratch words, and in a critical section opens an event with func_80119444 as handler, enables it, and sets and starts root counter RCnt with SetRCnt/StartRCnt.

name: init_display_buffers
what the code shows: Calls SetDefDrawEnv twice and SetDefDispEnv twice on two buffers at fixed addresses starting 0x801fc000, using a, b, c, d as the coordinates. It sets some bytes in both environments to 1 or 0, calls ClearImage on a rect of 0x3ff by 0x1ff at the origin, calls ClearOTagR on both buffers with length 0x1e, and sets data_801a27d0 to 0 and data_801987c8 to the first buffer.

name: count_pad_records_with_all_buttons_and_flag
what the code shows: Returns a count 0, 1 or 2. It adds one for each of two pad records (data_801a6966/data_801a696a and data_801a6972/data_801a6976) whose first word has all of bits 0x10f set and whose second word has bit 0x800 set. The arguments pad and number are not used.

name: init_snd_voices
what the code shows: Loops over three SndVoice records starting at 0x801fc200: sets status to 0 and stack_address to 0x801fec00 plus i*0x800, and writes 0x40000404 into a word at an offset (0x94 + 0xc0*(i+1)) from the pointer read at address 0x110.

name: start_pending_snd_voice_threads
what the code shows: Walks the SndVoice records from 0x801fc200 to 0x801fc37f using data_8018f5a0 as the cursor. For status 3 it opens a thread with OpenTh (inside EnterCriticalSection/ExitCriticalSection) and stores the handle in thread_handle; for status 3 (falling through) and 2 it sets status to 4 and switches to that thread with ChangeTh.

name: set_voice_thread_entry_and_open
what the code shows: Calls func_8011e938 with the address of VOICES[a].thread_entry and b (which calls DrawSync(0) and stores a table entry and the global pointer there), then calls func_801191dc with a and the thread_entry.

name: set_snd_ctl_thread_entry_and_close
what the code shows: Calls set_table_entry_and_global_pointer with the address of field_0c of the SndCtl at data_8018f5a0 and the argument a. Then calls close_sound_thread_and_switch_to_main with the field_0c value.

name: open_snd_voice_thread
what the code shows: Sets VOICES[a].status to 2 and, inside a critical section, opens a thread with OpenTh at address b using the voice's stack_address and field_10, storing the handle in thread_handle. It also copies bytes from game_state.field_35c, data_8019046c and data_8019047c into field_68 to field_6b of the voice.

name: request_sound_command_and_switch_thread
what the code shows: Stores the argument in field_02 and 1 in field_00 of the SndCtl at data_8018f5a0, then calls ChangeTh with 0xff000000 to switch to the first thread.

name: close_snd_thread_and_switch_main
what the code shows: Sets field_00 of the SndCtl at data_8018f5a0 to 0, closes its thread with CloseTh inside a critical section, then switches to the first thread (0xff000000) with ChangeTh.

name: close_voice_thread
what the code shows: For the record number a (0x80 bytes each from 0x801fc200), if its first u16 is nonzero it clears it and closes the thread whose handle is at offset 4 with CloseTh in a critical section.

name: close_sound_thread_and_switch_to_main
what the code shows: Sets field_00 of the SndCtl at data_8018f5a0 to 3 and field_0c to the argument. Inside a critical section it calls CloseTh on the thread_handle, then leaves the section and calls ChangeTh with 0xff000000.

name: set_voice_status_bit
what the code shows: Sets bit 0x10 in VOICES[a].status.

name: clear_voice_status_bit
what the code shows: Clears bit 0x10 in VOICES[a].status.

name: update_pad_and_count_frame
what the code shows: Calls update_pad_state, increments the counter data_801ac310, then calls func_80150638.

name: update_voice_delay_timers
what the code shows: For each SndVoice from 0x801fc200 to 0x801fc37f with status 1, decrements delay_timer and sets status to 2 when its low 16 bits reach zero.

name: swap_buffers_and_submit_draw_list
what the code shows: Toggles data_801a27d0 between 0 and 1 and makes data_801987c8 point to the buffer at 0x801fc000 + idx*0xe8, keeping the old buffer. It calls PutDispEnv and PutDrawEnv on parts of the new buffer, then calls LoadImage for each of 0x100 active entries in data_8018e598 and 0x10 in data_8018f5e4, and calls func_8011f504 or func_8011f55c on each. It calls func_80125b80 when game_state.field_31 is 0, calls func_801378d8 for each player whose data_8018daf4 flag is set, clears data_8018db14 and data_801adfe4, calls func_80119694 and DrawOTag on the old buffer's list, then ClearOTagR on the new buffer with 0x1e and clears data_801901be.

name: compact_linked_cell_runs
what the code shows: Walks backward through 32-bit cells from the address masked with 0xffffff, for at most 29 steps. It skips cells whose value points to the cell before them. At the end of each such run it writes the address of the first cell after the run into the top cell of the run.

name: update_pad_state
what the code shows: Reads two pad buffers from data_801a89a8 (valid if status 0 and id 0x41), inverts the button word and stores current, previous and newly-pressed words for each of two pads. It toggles data_801ac61c when pad 2's newly-pressed word has bit 0x800.

name: loop_init_state_and_load_game_state_from_table
what the code shows: Calls SetDispMask(1) and sets state_index of data_8018f5a0 to 0, then loops forever on it. In state 0 it clears two words, initialises objects, sprite tables and images, starts sound if the word at 0x1f800000 is zero and advances state_index. In states 1 and 2 it fills game_state fields from table_8016e664, clears the index fields, and calls switch_to_next_table_entry_and_wait. Each pass ends with request_sound_command_and_switch_thread(1).

name: load_images_to_vram
what the code shows: Calls func_8014f3b8 with 0 and 0, then in a loop of 0x2fb iterations calls LoadImage with 4x16 rectangles (x from a running column and base starting at 0x340, y from a row counter) and source data at 0x80010000 + i*128. Then calls LoadImage for two 16-wide rectangles at y 0x1f0 (x 0x160 and 0x70) from 0x80050000 and for a 0x40x0x100 rectangle at (0x3c0,0x100) from 0x80030000.

name: clear_anim_obj_stream_index
what the code shows: Sets the stream_index of the AnimObj to 0.

name: release_stream_pair_cells
what the code shows: For the obj's stream_index, releases both cells in data_80183ffc with their counts from data_801841bc via func_8011a6b8. Then zeroes both entries of data_801841bc and the first entries of data_8018437c for those two indices.

name: noop_empty_function_2
what the code shows: Empty function; does nothing and returns nothing.

name: release_table_index_cell_runs
what the code shows: For table_index of a, walks 7 entries of data_80183dc8 and data_80183da0, calls func_8011a6b8 with each data_80183da0 value and count, and zeroes the count.

name: queue_block_jobs_for_stream_difference
what the code shows: Calls queue_compressed_block_jobs with the AnimObj and the difference between data_80183bb0 and data_80183ad0 entries at the object's stream_index.

name: decode_blocks_divided_by_step_divisor
what the code shows: Clamps step_divisor to 0 if negative, then calls func_80119e74 with the remaining count (data_80183bb0 minus data_80183ad0 for stream_index) divided by step_divisor+1.

name: queue_compressed_block_jobs
what the code shows: Up to n times, takes a Job from func_8011f430 (stopping if 0), decodes a compressed block into job->src with decode_compressed_block, and fills the job with rect, kind 1 and index. It advances the row (wrapping at 16 to the next column from data_80183c90), and stores col, row and count back per stream_index.

name: init_sprite_cell_buffers
what the code shows: Clears several global tables (2x10 and 0x70-entry ones), builds a chain in data_80183c90 ending with 0xffff, and sets data_801846fc=1 and data_80184700=0x6f. It then initialises the 16-pixel sprite cells in data_801987cc with SetSprt16, grey colour 0x80 and a GetClut(0x60,0x1e0) clut, and sets draw modes with SetDrawMode and GetTPage for data_8018db18 and data_8019056c.

name: clear_side_tables
what the code shows: Zeroes data_801900f8, data_801900f4, table_801aa4d8 and the 32 entries of table_801ac318 for each of two sides. It also zeroes the data_80185c84, data_80185cc4 and data_80185ce4 entries for 2 sides x 4 slots.

name: clear_object_side_table_entries
what the code shows: Zeroes entries [0] and [1] of data_80185c84, data_80185cc4 and data_80185ce4, indexed by the object's side (via field_3c) and its field_03.

name: get_free_list_head
what the code shows: Returns data_801846fc, the head of the free list.

name: alloc_slot_after
what the code shows: Takes the head of the free list in data_80183c90 and decrements the free count. It then follows b links from index a and inserts the taken entry after that cell, returning it, or 0xffff if no entries are free.

name: free_slot_chain
what the code shows: If b is nonzero, follows b-1 links in data_80183c90 from index a and links that last cell to the free-list head. It makes a the new head and adds b to the free count.

name: init_sprite_tables
what the code shows: Calls func_8011a018, func_8011a410, func_801511c8 and func_801518a0 in turn, which clear tables and initialise sprite and polygon primitives.

name: noop_empty_function_3
what the code shows: Empty function; does nothing and returns nothing.

name: select_buffers_and_run_first_setup
what the code shows: Loads four global pointers from tables indexed by data_801a27d0 (data_801987cc, data_8018db18, data_801987cc entry plus 0x280, data_8019056c). If game_state.setup_done_flag is 0 it calls six setup/draw routines (func_80134234, func_8011a880, func_8011acbc, func_8011b594, func_8011b708, func_80136ccc) and sets the flag to 1 and data_801a695c to 0. It then clears data_801aa540 and calls func_8011ff24.

name: set_part_modes_and_update_both_player_parts
what the code shows: Sets part_mode of player_left and player_right: from field_73 and compare_value when either field_73 is nonzero, otherwise from which frame's value_a is larger. Then for each player calls func_8011bc84 on enabled part_28, part_2c, part_30, part_34 blocks (field_09 = part_mode + 4), calls func_8011cbb8 and draw_object_tile_grid_prims when field_00 and parts_active_flag are set.

name: update_active_slab172_entries
what the code shows: Sets data_801a4fe8 from data_801987cc and data_801a697c from data_8018db18, both indexed by data_801a27d0. It then calls func_8011bc84 on each of the 40 entries of data_801a89f4 whose active_flag and field_01 are both nonzero.

name: draw_all_block172_entries
what the code shows: Loops a counter byte from 0 to 39 over the 172-byte entries of data_801a89f4. For each active and enabled entry it calls a drawing routine chosen by field_02, type_code and handler_gate: func_8011cd68, func_80134624, func_801452ec, func_8011bc84 (also on linked entries), or a func_801e routine chosen by game_state.kind_index.

name: update_enabled_units_by_handler_index
what the code shows: Loops over 16 entries of units_2c20; for each with active and handler_enable nonzero, calls build_block_primitives if handler_index is 0x17, else func_8011bc84.

name: call_block_update_for_enabled_entries
what the code shows: Loops over 16 entries of data_801ac888 and calls func_8011bc84 on each whose active_flag and enabled_flag are both nonzero.

name: call_handler_by_mode_for_active_entries
what the code shows: Loops over 16 entries of data_801ac888, with the index kept in the byte data_8019045c. For each entry that has active_flag, field_01 and data_80190568 set and field_81 equal to 4, it calls one of 19 handler functions chosen by game_state.field_40.

name: reload_stream_cells_then_build_sprite_quads
what the code shows: Computes the address of the sequence's data pointer plus stream_base. If reload_flag is set it clears it, shifts and unpacks cell lists into stream cells (or drops the second cell run), and queues block jobs for the next sequence data address. Otherwise it decodes blocks divided by step_divisor. It always ends with build_sprite_quads_from_stream.

name: get_sequence_data_address
what the code shows: Reads the block's sequence step. It takes data_ptr from the step at loop_offset if flags has 0x8000, otherwise from the next step. It returns that value rounded down to even plus block->field_9c.

name: shift_stream_second_cell_to_first
what the code shows: Releases the first cell run of stream_index via func_8011a6b8, shifts the second entries of data_80183ffc, data_801841bc and data_8018437c into the first, and clears the second count. Sets stream_index to 0 if both cells or both counts are zero.

name: unpack_cell_list_into_stream_cells
what the code shows: Reads a packed cell list q (modes 0, 2, 4, 6: plain, with per-entry flags, run-length, or both) and writes xor-masked words and 5-bit flags into data_80184704 and data_80185504 on cells from the free list. Then it records the new run as the first entry in the stream's tables and shifts the old first entry to the second slot. If the list does not fit, it calls func_8011c568 instead.

name: drop_second_stream_cell_run
what the code shows: Releases the second cell run of stream_index via func_8011a6b8, moves the first entries to the second, and resets the first to the index itself with zero counts. Sets stream_index to 0 if both are empty, and resets data_80183910 to the index and data_801839f0, data_80183ad0, data_80183bb0 to 0.

name: build_sprite_quads_from_stream
what the code shows: Builds a run of sprite quads for the SpriteObj from a header table entry (count, offset) and a stream of 16-bit deltas, mirrored by the flag bits in field_0b. For each quad it sets x, y, tile_offset and a CLUT from GetClut, calls AddPrim for each, and stores the advanced quad pointer in data_801a4fe8. It returns early if the index, header, tile, table value or count is zero.

name: reload_cell_history_then_build_cell_prims
what the code shows: Computes the sequence data address plus stream_base. If reload_flag is set or the stream_key differs from the first history entry, it shifts the history tables, unpacks or pushes cell lists for the current and next sequence data, and queues block jobs. Otherwise it decodes blocks by step_divisor. It then calls build_cell_prim_list_from_history and fill_cell_record_rects_from_history.

name: build_block_primitives
what the code shows: Takes block->data_ptr and calls func_8011d74c and then func_8011db78 with it, block_mode, field_20 and the block.

name: shift_history_tables_down
what the code shows: For index field_02, either keeps the count of the first entry in the second (when the first two entries of the tables match and the second count is 0) or releases the first run via func_8011a6b8. Then shifts all four tables of 10 entries down by one and zeroes the last count.

name: unpack_cell_list_with_history
what the code shows: Unpacks the cell list q (modes 0, 2, 4, 6) into data_80184704 and data_80185504 on cells from the free list, with xor mask from stream_key and flags. It shifts the ten-entry history tables of field_02 up by one, stores the new run in entry 0 and sets stream_index. If the list does not fit, it calls func_8011d5b8 instead.

name: push_front_of_cell_history
what the code shows: Releases the last (index 9) cell run via func_8011a6b8, shifts the four history tables up by one, and stores stream_key, stream_index and q in the first entry with count 0. It resets data_80183910, data_801839f0, data_80183ad0 and data_80183bb0 for the stream_index.

name: build_cell_prim_list_from_history
what the code shows: Finds a history entry from func_801250c0 and data_801900f8; if valid, it builds a list of cell commands (size, column, clut from GetClut) and SetDrawMode primitives added with AddPrim into a list cleared with ClearOTag. It skips the work if the cached header, size and clut offset are unchanged.

name: fill_cell_record_rects_from_history
what the code shows: Finds a history entry like the sibling builder. It walks the header's data to compute each record's rect_x and rect_y from running x/y offsets and mode bits (flip x and y), writes them into the records, then calls AddPrims on the list entry.

name: decode_compressed_block
what the code shows: Decodes a compressed block of 16-bit words from data (selected by b's low 14 bits) into out, with the address XORed by a mask chosen from b's top bits. It handles raw, flag-coded copy, bitmap and byte-coded forms, and bit 0x8000 swaps the nibbles of each word.

name: decode_rle_nibble_swapped
what the code shows: Decodes a run-length-coded stream of n bytes with flag bitmasks at the start, writing bytes to dst ^ key. Each value byte has its nibbles swapped, and a flagged value is repeated by the following count byte.

name: decode_rle
what the code shows: Decodes a run-length-coded stream of n bytes with flag bitmasks at the start, writing bytes to dst ^ key. A flagged value is repeated by the following count byte. Unlike func_8011e5c8, nibbles are not swapped.

name: init_cd
what the code shows: Calls CdInit and returns nothing.

name: set_table_entry_and_global_pointer
what the code shows: Calls DrawSync(0), then stores table_8016e6b8[index] in out[0] and the global pointer register value in out[1].

name: load_file_from_host
what the code shows: Calls DrawSync(0), then repeatedly opens the file at data_8016e6a0 + h*24 through the debugging host calls, reads its size, and reads it into buf rounded up to 0x800 bytes. It closes the file and returns the size, retrying on any error.

name: load_image_from_stream
what the code shows: Sets the stream pointer to p with func_8015a560 and reads a header into buf with func_8015a570. It calls DrawSync, LoadImage with buf[3],buf[4], and a second LoadImage with buf[1],buf[2] if buf[0] has bit 8, then DrawSync again.

name: noop_empty_function_4
what the code shows: Empty function; does nothing and returns nothing.

name: noop_empty_function_5
what the code shows: Empty function; does nothing and returns nothing.

name: clear_arrays_and_init_pools_and_sprite_tables
what the code shows: Calls clear_four_144_byte_arrays, init_object_pools and init_sprite_tables in turn.

name: clear_players_arrays_state_and_init_pools
what the code shows: Calls clear_players, clear_four_144_byte_arrays, clear_game_state_fields and init_object_pools in turn.

name: init_object_pools
what the code shows: Calls func_8011ef34, then resets the allocation cursor and zeroes and sets up several pools of fixed-size blocks (16 of 0xc0 bytes, 40 of 0xac, 16 of 0xac), storing their addresses in tables. It also initialises tables of 256 and 16 small records and sets assorted counters.

name: init_block172_pool
what the code shows: Sets data_801a27d4 and data_801a27cc to 8 and data_80197f10 to 0x27. It then zeroes 40 consecutive 0xac-byte blocks from data_801a89f4, sets each block's field_08 to 0xc, and stores their addresses in table_80197f20.

name: clear_players
what the code shows: Zeroes 0x394 bytes starting at player_left and the next 0x394 bytes after it.

name: reset_both_players
what the code shows: Sets ref_other.p to player_left and calls func_8011ef88 on it, then does the same for the next object (the right player).

name: reset_object_fields
what the code shows: Calls func_80119b34, sets state_0 to state_3 and several other fields of the object to 0, and zeroes the bytes from field_128 up to offset 0x391.

name: clear_four_144_byte_arrays
what the code shows: Clears 0x90 bytes in each of four byte arrays: data_801aa544, data_801aa5d4, cam_obj and data_801904d8.

name: clear_game_state_fields
what the code shows: Zeroes 0x80 bytes starting at game_state.field_40 and sets game_state.field_226 to 0.

name: clear_data_block_and_game_state_bytes
what the code shows: Clears 0xac bytes starting at data_801ae02c, sets its byte 8 to 0x18, and clears game_state.field_06, field_04 and field_05.

name: pop_object_from_pool
what the code shows: If data_801a6960 is nonzero, takes the entry at that index of data_801a89b0, decrements the count, clears its field_a1, calls func_80119b34 and returns it. Otherwise returns 0.

name: reset_and_push_block_object_type_8
what the code shows: Releases the stream cells with func_80119b3c, zeroes 0xc0 bytes of the record, sets type_code to 8 and clears several fields and four linked entries. It then increments data_801a6960 and stores the record in data_801a89b0 at that index.

name: pop_block_from_pool
what the code shows: If data_80197f10 is nonzero, takes the entry at that index of table_80197f20, decrements the count, calls func_80119b34 on it and returns it. Otherwise returns 0.

name: reset_and_push_object_to_pool_table
what the code shows: Counts data_801a27cc and data_801a27d4 for field_02 10 (mode not 4) and 4. It releases cells with func_80119b3c, zeroes 0xac bytes, sets type_code to 12 and clears linked entries. Then it increments data_80197f10 and stores the record in table_80197f20.

name: pop_object_from_second_pool
what the code shows: If data_801a4fec is nonzero, takes the entry at that index of data_801a68f0, decrements the count, calls func_80119b34 on it and returns it. Otherwise returns 0.

name: clear_object_and_push_on_free_stack
what the code shows: Calls release_stream_pair_cells on the object and zeroes its 0xac bytes. Sets spawn_flag to 0, mode_id to 0x10 and scroll_factor to 0. Increments data_801a4fec and stores the object in data_801a68f0 at that index.

name: clear_bytes
what the code shows: Sets n bytes at p to zero.

name: alloc_pooled_a
what the code shows: Pops a Pooled pointer from the stack data_801a4fe4 if data_801ac618 is nonzero, decrementing it and incrementing data_801abefc. It zeroes the entry's fields 08 to 0e and returns it, else returns 0.

name: alloc_pooled_b
what the code shows: Pops a Pooled pointer from the stack data_801a6980 if data_801ad348 is nonzero, decrementing it. It zeroes the entry's fields 08 to 0e and returns it, else returns 0.

name: release_pooled_to_stack_a
what the code shows: Pushes p onto the stack at data_801a4fe4 and advances that pointer. It increments data_801ac618, decrements data_801abefc, and zeroes active_flag and fields 08 to 0e of p.

name: release_pooled_to_stack_b
what the code shows: Increments data_801ad348, pushes p onto the stack at data_801a6980 and advances that pointer, then zeroes active_flag and fields 08 to 0e of p.

name: update_player_inputs_and_handlers
what the code shows: Saves input_bits to prev_input_bits for both players, and copies data_801a6966 and data_801a6972 into the input_bits unless versus_flag is set and data_801a6984[0] is nonzero. When game_state.field_31 is 0, it calls func_8011f774 and call_handler_by_side for each player.

name: call_handler_by_side
what the code shows: Calls the function in handlers_by_side indexed by object->side with the object. The second argument is unused.

name: call_counter_update_if_right_field_zero
what the code shows: Calls func_8011f70c with the object if player_right.field_165 is 0.

name: call_counter_update_if_left_field_zero
what the code shows: Calls func_8011f70c with the object if player_left.field_165 is 0.
If cursor_timer_b is nonzero: sets field_16a to 1, decrements cursor_timer_b and field_7e, and clears field_225 if field_7e has bit 0x80. Also increments frame_count, capped at 0xad.

name: count_down_cursor_timer_a_and_set_cursor
what the code shows: If cursor_timer_a is nonzero, decrements it and sets game_state.cursor to table_80185cf4 or table_80185e50 by object side. Also increments field_180, capped at 0xad.

name: advance_sequence_rec
what the code shows: Counts step_timer down; at zero takes the next SeqRec (or the one at its header if step_flags is negative) and calls func_8011fa50 with it.

name: advance_sequence_rec_2
what the code shows: Counts step_timer down; at zero takes the next SeqRec (or the one at its header if step_flags is negative) and calls func_8011fa50 with it.

name: advance_sequence_rec_3
what the code shows: Counts step_timer down; at zero takes the next SeqRec (or the one at its header if step_flags is negative) and calls func_8011fa50 with it.

name: set_sequence_from_table
what the code shows: Calls func_8011fa50 with the object and the SeqRec at table[index].

name: set_sequence_record_with_default_base
what the code shows: Calls func_8011f994 with the object, rec and the global data_801aa594.

name: set_sequence_from_table_2
what the code shows: Calls func_8011fa50 with the object and the SeqRec at table[index].

name: set_sequence_record_with_default_base_2
what the code shows: Calls func_8011f994 with the object, rec and data_801aa594.

name: set_sequence_and_copy_block
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence to rec and loads step_timer and step_flags from rec->header. It computes an offset from pos_x and pos_y and calls func_8011fae0 with rec->data and a destination at base plus that offset.

name: set_sequence_from_table_3
what the code shows: Calls func_8011fa50 with the object and the SeqRec at table[index].

name: set_sequence_and_copy_data_to_map
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence to rec, loads step_timer and step_flags from rec->header, and computes an offset into the cam_obj map from pos_x and pos_y. It calls func_8011fb70 with rec->data and that map address.

name: copy_block_pairs_wide
what the code shows: Copies a block of 32-bit pairs (two u16) from src to dst: header gives width w and height h, each row copies w pairs with dst advancing 64 u16 per pair, then moves to the next row. It returns nothing.

name: copy_block_pairs_narrow
what the code shows: Same as the 128-stride copy but with a row stride of 32 u16 per pair: reads width and height from src, copies pairs of u16 into dst stepping 32 u16 per pair and adjusts at each row end.

name: advance_sequence_rec_4
what the code shows: Counts step_timer down; at zero takes the next SeqRec (or the one at its header if step_flags is negative) and calls func_8011fa50 with it.

name: set_sequence_from_table_4
what the code shows: Calls func_8011fa50 with the object and the SeqRec at table[index].

name: set_sequence_record
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence to rec, step_timer to the high 16 bits of rec->header and step_flags to its low bits, then calls func_8011fcc0 with rec.

name: store_rect_entries_and_queue_kinds
what the code shows: Unless data_8018f598 is nonzero, it reads 4-word entries from rec->data until one has bit 0x8000, calling func_80137640 with a 16x1 rect, the third word and the kind byte. It then calls func_80137220 for each kind 1, 2, 3 and 0 seen, with 0, 1, 2 and 6.

name: reset_side_table_and_fields
what the code shows: Sets game_state.cursor to table_80185cf4 (or table_80185e50 if side is nonzero) and zeroes 43 words through it. It sets object->field_c2 to 0xf0fc, zeroes field_180, field_182, field_2a2 and field_2a1, and sets field_267 to 1.

name: set_digits_from_number
what the code shows: Writes the 16 decimal digits of n, least significant first, into game_state.digits.

name: copy_three_globals_and_clear_three
what the code shows: Copies data_8018f5e0, data_8019036c and data_801903ac into data_801ad354, data_8018db00 and data_8018db04. It clears data_80190104, data_80190100 and data_8018f59c.

name: set_state_0_if_x_outside_margin_narrow
what the code shows: Sets state_0 of the Object to 3 when its 16-bit pos_x minus box_margin[0] plus 0x40 exceeds 0x200, as an unsigned 16-bit value.

name: set_state_0_if_x_outside_margin_wide
what the code shows: Sets state_0 of the Object to 3 when pos_x minus box_margin[0] plus 0x80 exceeds 0x280, as an unsigned 16-bit value.

name: clear_or_set_flag_by_pos_x_limit
what the code shows: Computes pos_x minus the 16-bit box_margin[0] plus 64. If that exceeds 512 it sets field_01 to 0, else it calls set_flag_and_push_if_mode_8.

name: set_flag_and_push_if_mode_8
what the code shows: Sets field_01 of the object to 1 and calls func_80120060 (push_object_by_ot_depth) if mode_id is 8.

name: push_object_by_ot_depth_wrapper
what the code shows: Calls push_object_by_ot_depth with the object.

name: push_object_by_ot_depth
what the code shows: Stores o at stack_801ad354 (post-decrement) and increments count_8018f59c. It then calls push_object_stack_a if o->ot_depth is 0, else push_object_stack_b.

name: push_object_stack_a
what the code shows: Stores o at the position pointed to by stack_8018db00, decrements that pointer, and increments count_80190100.

name: push_object_stack_b
what the code shows: Stores o at the position pointed to by stack_8018db04, decrements that pointer, and increments count_80190104.

name: init_sound_system
what the code shows: Calls SsInit, SsSetTableSize with data_801953d0, 4 and 16, SsSetTickMode(1) and func_8014f408(3,0). Then stores four pointers at fixed negative offsets from data_801953d0 into ptr_80197ee8[0..3].

name: start_sound_and_set_volumes
what the code shows: Calls SsStart2, SsSetMVol(0x7f,0x7f), SsSeqSetVol for four sequences from data_80190a44[4..7] at 0x7f, SsSetSerialAttr(0,0,1), func_8016904c(0,0x50,0x50) and func_80120374(1).

name: close_sound_and_quit
what the code shows: Closes the VABs data_80190a44[0..3] with SsVabClose, the SEPs [8..11] with SsSepClose and the SEQs [4..7] with SsSeqClose. It then calls func_801656ec and SsQuit.

name: set_sound_mono_or_stereo
what the code shows: Calls SsSetMono if a is 0, else SsSetStereo, then calls func_8014f5d4 with 0 or 1 respectively.

name: close_vab_and_sep
what the code shows: Calls SsVabClose on data_80190a44[a] and SsSepClose on data_80190a44[a+8].

name: stop_all_keys_clear_table
what the code shows: Calls SsUtAllKeyOff(0), then zeroes 24 bytes in a table at offset 0x748c from data_80190a44.

name: stop_sep_by_index
what the code shows: Calls SsSepStop on data_80190a44[a+8] with the sequence number from table_8016e6e0[a][b*2] masked with 0xfff.

name: stop_sep_by_word
what the code shows: Splits a into high byte hi and low byte, then calls SsSepStop on data_80190a44[hi+8] with table_8016e6e0[hi][low*2] masked with 0xfff.

name: call_func_with_side_x_origin
what the code shows: Chooses d as 64 if a is 0, else 320, and calls func_80120604 with the high byte and low byte of c, a and d.

name: noop_empty_function_6
what the code shows: Empty function; does nothing and returns nothing.

name: play_object_sound_by_kind
what the code shows: Calls play_sound_at for o with the side and a sound 0x32b if field_293 is nonzero, else 0x315 if bit kind of 0x10d40 is set, else 0x314.

name: play_kind_dependent_sound_by_a_and_b
what the code shows: Plays sound 0x32a if field_293 is set. It then plays a sound chosen from a, b and a bit test of 0x10d40 against kind. The sound numbers are 0x316–0x318 and 0x349–0x34b.

name: play_sound_from_table_by_direction_index
what the code shows: Calls play_sound_at with the object, its field_02, and a word from table_8016e6f0 indexed by bits 1-2 of direction_index.

name: init_hud_indices_and_loop_game_state_updates
what the code shows: Clears three globals and the index fields of data_8018f5a0, clears game_state.fade_busy and wait_flag, and switches thread with request_sound_command_and_switch_thread(1). It then loops forever: it increments loop_counter, sets pass_flag to 0xff, calls func_80120c14, update_player_inputs_and_handlers and call_handler_by_stage_0_1, and switches thread again when pass_flag or pending_flag is 0.

name: update_pending_flag_from_table_bit
what the code shows: Clears field_74. If pending_flag is set, sets field_74 to 0xff and clears pending_flag. Otherwise, if field_6d is nonzero, tests bit (loop_counter & 0xf) of table_8016e720[table_index_3] and sets pending_flag to -1 if set.

name: call_handler_by_stage_0_1
what the code shows: Reads the stage of data_8018f5a0. If it is 0, it calls func_80120cf0 with the state. If it is 1, it calls func_80120f98 with the state.

name: reset_game_state_for_round
what the code shows: Resets the game state for a new round. It increments the state_index of data_8018f5a0, calls func_8011eb14, clears many state fields and loads others from tables. It calls init_player_object for both players, sets side fields for the sides in side_bits, and calls func_80120374 and func_80138358.

name: init_player_object
what the code shows: Sets the object's field_00 and field_cd to 1, field_02 and side to a1, field_fc to 0x90, and field_c2 to a2. It zeroes win_streak and several other fields.

name: call_handler_by_phase_index_unless_flags_set
what the code shows: Unless both data_801ac61c and data_801a89f0 are nonzero, calls the handler in table_8016e738 at the phase_index of data_8018f5a0 with the state.

name: advance_phase_and_clear_player_flags
what the code shows: Increments phase_index of data_8018f5a0, sets alt_flag to 1 and field_64 to 0 in the state, and clears field_01 of both players. Then it calls func_8011eae4.

name: init_or_dispatch_step_by_mode_flags
what the code shows: If step_index of data_8018f5a0 is 0, it calls func_8011a744, increments step_index, calls func_8014edac with 1 if data_8016e68b or mode_flag_a or mode_flag_b is nonzero (else 0), and clears substep_index, step_index_2, pass_index and field_54. Otherwise it calls func_801b0000 or func_80010000 (by data_8016e68b) when both mode flags are 0, func_801b2194 when only mode_flag_a is set, or func_801b4a88 when only mode_flag_b is set. When step_index is 2 it resets it to 0 and increments phase_index.

name: load_side_command_once_else_call_next
what the code shows: If pass_index of data_8018f5a0 is 0, it increments it, gets an object via func_80125060, stores it in state->object and calls load_command_6_for_side_and_wait with the object's kind and side. Otherwise it calls func_80010058 with the state.

name: call_func_ignoring_argument
what the code shows: Ignores its argument and calls func_80010b2c.

name: load_focus_object_sound_then_set_phase_4
what the code shows: If pass_index of data_8018f5a0 is 0, it increments it, sets game_state.object from state->focus_object and calls func_8014eef8 with state->audio_arg and state->sound_side. Otherwise it sets phase_index to 4.

name: call_handler_by_step_index
what the code shows: Calls the handler in table_8016e760 at the step_index of data_8018f5a0 with the state.

name: init_match_state_and_players
what the code shows: Advances step_index of the SndCtl at data_8018f5a0 and clears its substep_index, step_index_2 and pass_index. It zeroes many GameState fields and both players' fields (win_count, meter, effect_request and others), and sets field_09 to 1, reset_value to 7, init_timer_value to 0x3c, round_time from table_value_b, and copies mode, saved_value and table_value_c. It clears the scores when mode is 3, and calls func_801263d8 and func_801262fc when mode3_active_flag and versus_flag are 0. It calls func_80123b88, link_players, func_8011eae4, func_8013839c, func_8014e890, func_8014eb9c, func_80136dc4, func_80151020(0x604), func_801192bc(1), SetDispMask(1) and close_voice_thread(2), and sets data_80190568 to 1.

name: link_players
what the code shows: Sets the two objects' other pointers to each other (player_left and the one after it), sets field_0d to 0x10 and 0xb, and stores the player pointers into state. For each object with field_cd nonzero it sets field_d4 to 0, then to 1 if the kinds are equal and the other's field_d4 is 0.

name: call_handler_by_substep_index
what the code shows: Calls func_80121780 with the object when substep_index of data_8018f5a0 is 0, or func_801217d4 when it is 1.

name: advance_substep_and_reset_object_ids
what the code shows: Increments substep_index of data_8018f5a0, clears phase_state of the object, calls func_801285e0 and func_801e1d0c(0), then sets state_2 and team_id of the object to 0xff.

name: call_step_handler_then_update_blocks_and_buffers
what the code shows: Calls the handler in table_8016e774 at step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0. If data_801ae02c is nonzero it calls func_801e1b64 and func_801e1d6c. Then calls update_blocks, call_active_block_handlers, set_capped_value_and_ot_indices and select_buffers_and_run_first_setup.

name: advance_step_and_finish_on_field_af
what the code shows: Increments field_50 of data_8018f5a0 and ORs 0xe into field_dc of the Object. If field_af is nonzero, it sets field_50 to 0xc and field_60 to 0x10. It also sets ot_depth to 1, field_2c to 0xff, calls func_8013245c, clears field_ab, and clears field_01 of player_left and player_right.

name: spawn_six_objects_on_first_state
what the code shows: If object->state_2 is 0, it increments step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0, sets countdown_timer to 0x20 and clears several object fields. It takes six objects from func_8011f1e0 and sets field_02 to 0x31, 0x32 and 0x17, with indices and the players as parent.

name: count_down_or_skip_to_next_step_2
what the code shows: If func_80125268 returns nonzero, it adds 2 to step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0 and sets the object's phase_state to 1. Otherwise it decrements countdown_timer. When that goes negative it resets it to 0x3f, increments step_index_2 and calls func_80121b00.

name: scale_palette_rows_and_queue_four_uploads
what the code shows: Calls func_80125dc0 four times with fixed rows, counts and scales (the first call is repeated), then queues image upload jobs for pairs (0,6), (1,0), (2,1), (3,2). The object argument is not used.

name: advance_step_when_countdown_expires
what the code shows: If func_80125268 returns nonzero, or the countdown_timer of data_8018f5a0 decremented by one goes below zero, it increments step_index_2, sets data_80190a40 to 1, calls func_801373e8 and sets phase_state of the object to 1.

name: advance_step_index_2_and_restore_then_clear_rows
what the code shows: Increments step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0, then calls restore_rows_from_backup_rows and clear_row_columns_once_and_update_jobs.

name: advance_step_index_2_and_set_countdown_timer
what the code shows: Increments step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0, clears data_80190a40, and calls restore_rows_from_backup_rows. Sets countdown_timer to 0x78 and the object's team_id to 0.

name: wait_countdown_then_set_phase_state_2
what the code shows: If func_80125268 returns nonzero, it calls func_8014f4d4(6, 3). If func_80125268 is nonzero or countdown_timer decremented goes negative, it increments step_index_2, sets countdown_timer to 0x1c and sets the object's phase_state to 2.

name: count_down_hud_timer_then_advance_step
what the code shows: Decrements field_60 of data_8018f5a0. When it goes negative, it clears field_52, sets sub_timer to 4 and increments field_50.

name: advance_pass_index_then_next_step
what the code shows: Switches on pass_index of data_8018f5a0. Cases 0 and 1 count sub_timer down and advance pass_index at below zero (case 0 also calls func_8011a744). Case 2 advances step_index, resets other indices, sets entity fields, calls func_8013245c and may set data_80197f1c to 0xff.

name: count_down_timer_2_then_set_step_index_d
what the code shows: If game_state.busy_flag is 0, decrements the 16-bit countdown_timer_2; when it goes negative, sets step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0 to 0xd and calls func_80124ecc. The Object argument is unused.

name: set_step_index_2_if_not_busy
what the code shows: If game_state.busy_flag is 0, sets step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0 to 0xb.

name: update_game_frame
what the code shows: Calls func_80123e34 when leader_bits (or field_226 in versus) is 0. Then, depending on field_31 and versus mode, it either calls substate handlers, or it calls the handler at table_8016e7ac[substep_index] and, unless field_4f is set, runs the per-frame update. That update counts down countdown_timer_b and countdown_timer and increments frame_counter. It also stores field_a8 and, when field_84 bit 0x80 is clear, calls the input, unit, overlap-separation, block-handler and health-bar routines. It always ends by calling func_8011a784.

name: call_state_table_entry
what the code shows: Calls the function at table_8016e7bc indexed by state_index of data_8018f5a0, passing state.

name: reset_round_fields_and_advance_step_2
what the code shows: Increments step_index_2 of data_8018f5a0 and clears many fields of the state and of both players. It sets field_01 of both players to 1, sets field_87 to 0xff when round_count equals win_target*2-1, and under some conditions sets phase to 1 and kind_code from a player's kind. Ends by calling func_80138410.

name: advance_step_and_clear_entity_fields
what the code shows: Clears field_83 and field_4f of the entity and increments field_50 of data_8018f5a0. If field_84 is 0, it also clears field_09 and field_2c.

name: update_phase_by_pass_index
what the code shows: Unless data_80197fc4 or data_80198358 is 0x701: if phase is nonzero it runs a pass sequence (pass 0: fades four palette rows with func_80125dc0, calls func_80137b10, clears data_801ac6a8[0], sets phase to 0x80; pass 1: calls func_8014f038; else calls func_801e0020). If phase is 0 it sets step_index_2 to 3, clears three fields and sets data_801ac6a8[0] to 1.

name: advance_state_index_and_set_menu_command_by_kind
what the code shows: Increments state_index of data_8018f5a0 and sets field_6c of the entity to 1. If pass_count is 0, calls set_menu_command_by_code with 1 and the table_8016e6f8 entry for game_state.kind_index.
If field_6c is 4, sets step_index_2 to 0, increments substep_index, clears countdown_timer and field_4e, sets active_flag of three data_801aa544 entries to 1 and field_6d to 1.

name: update_round_timer_and_end_round
what the code shows: If skip_flag is set, it sets field_6d to 0 and field_2c and field_4e to 0xff and returns. Otherwise it counts down countdown under some conditions, calling set_winner_by_health when the time runs out. If mode is nonzero, it picks winner and loser through func_801227d4 and func_801229b4 (unless mode is 3), advances substep_index of data_8018f5a0, sets several flags and calls func_80138964 and func_801257d0.

name: update_round_winner
what the code shows: Picks winner and loser from player_left and the next object by side (2 swaps them), stores them in a, and increments the winner's field_ce. When it reaches a->field_48 it sets flags and, in mode field_1b == 3, updates win_streak and win tables. Otherwise, for a non-field_cd winner, it copies health into field_fc.

name: add_hit_value_to_both_scores_if_countdown
what the code shows: If countdown is nonzero, computes field_255 + 2 of ref_first.p and a table value via get_table_value_and_count_hit. Stores the sum in effect_code_bc, then calls add_table_bcd_to_player_total and add_table_bcd_score_to_player with the value and team_id.

name: call_hud_handler_by_state_index
what the code shows: Calls the function in table_8016e7d0 indexed by state_index of the HudBig at data_8018f5a0 with state, then calls func_8012546c.

name: advance_state_and_set_countdown_timer_2
what the code shows: Increments state_index of data_8018f5a0, clears field_116 and sets countdown_timer_2 to 0x32. If countdown is nonzero it calls func_80123b20 with field_7c; otherwise it may set countdown_timer_2 to 0x14. It copies team_id of field_78 to field_88 if set, then calls func_80122b3c.

name: count_down_then_advance_state_index
what the code shows: If countdown is nonzero, it sets field_11a to 0xff and decrements countdown. Otherwise it increments state_index of data_8018f5a0 and sets field_6c to 5. If field_11a is nonzero, it also calls func_8014f4d4(5, 1).

name: check_table_value_then_advance_state
what the code shows: If table_compare_value differs from table_8016e7e0 at table_index it calls func_80122c5c. Otherwise it increments state_index, sets countdown_timer to 0xa0 or 0x5a by mode_flag_b, and calls func_80155f30 with field_7c if field_4d and nonzero_flag are 0.

name: update_entity_countdowns_and_sounds
what the code shows: When field_4d and field_116 are 0, it counts down countdown_timer_2 and at zero calls func_80123b20 for field_7c or both players. When countdown_2 equals 0x1e it decrements it and may set data_80190474, and plays sound 0x208 or 0x209 with play_sound_at.

name: advance_step_or_reset_on_timer
what the code shows: If field_6c is 0: when mode_flag_b is 0 it increments step_count of data_8018f5a0, clears field_c8, countdown_timer, substate_index and field_cc, and sets state_index to 5 if nonzero_flag or field_78's mode_flag_2 is set, else sets state_index 0 and field_ac to 0xff. When mode_flag_b is set it decrements countdown_timer and calls func_80122e54 when it reaches zero.

name: reset_game_state_for_new_match
what the code shows: Resets game_state and data_8018f5a0 counters and flags, clears win_count and meter of both players, changes kind 0x13 to 0x11, sets init_timer_value to 0x3c and round_time from table_value_b. It then calls func_8011eae4, func_80136c8c, func_8013245c, func_801285e0 and func_80120408, and sets data_80197f1c to 0xff if the u16 at data_801a6984 is nonzero.

name: call_hud_handler_by_state_index_2
what the code shows: Calls the function in table_8016e7d0 indexed by state_index of the record at data_8018f5a0, passing state, then calls func_8012546c.

name: advance_state_by_mode_flag_a
what the code shows: If mode_flag_a is 0 it increments state_index of data_8018f5a0, sets countdown_timer to 0x1e and calls func_80156084, func_80156094 and func_8012304c. Otherwise it sets state_index to 5, countdown_timer to 0xa0 and calls func_8012332c.

name: set_selected_value_by_input_threshold
what the code shows: Sets selected_value to 4 if threshold_input is below 0x500, else to 0x100.

name: transfer_bcd_amount_to_score
what the code shows: When the focus_object's mode_flag_2 is 0, it calls func_8012304c and then either finishes (if func_80125394 is nonzero or bcd_step_amount exceeds bcd_amount) by adding the whole bcd_amount to the object's score with add_bcd, clearing it and advancing step_index_2, or adds bcd_step_amount to the score and subtracts it from bcd_amount. It calls func_80156094 and plays sound 0x34d (every fourth frame while stepping).

name: wait_countdown_or_set_state_index_5
what the code shows: If a9_flag is 0, it tests func_80125394. If that is 0 and countdown_timer after the decrement is not negative, it calls func_80156094 and returns. Otherwise it sets state_index of data_8018f5a0 to 5. If a9_flag is nonzero, it increments state_index.

name: advance_hud_step_and_set_field_ca
what the code shows: Increments field_50 of data_8018f5a0 and sets field_ca of the entity to 0x1e.

name: raise_focus_health_to_max_step
what the code shows: Unless func_80125394 is nonzero, it counts countdown_timer_2 down and returns while it is non-negative. Then every fourth frame it decrements countdown_3. While that stays below 0x80 and focus_object health is not 0x90, it adds 1 to health and copies it to y_offset. Otherwise it increments step_index_2, sets countdown_timer_2 to 0x5a and copies health to saved_health.

name: finish_countdown_and_start_next_round
what the code shows: Unless func_80125394 is nonzero, counts countdown_timer down and returns while it is non-negative. Then it resets the HUD and entity fields, stops sequences with func_80120444 and func_80120408, and depending on flags calls func_80123534 or func_80123748, or reinitialises the round via func_8011eae4, func_80136c8c, func_8013245c and func_801285e0.

name: call_menu_command_if_input_enabled
what the code shows: If game_state.input_enable_bits is nonzero, it calls func_8014f4d4(6, 2). The argument is unused.

name: update_pair_selection_or_reset_by_mode_flag_a
what the code shows: If entity->mode_flag_a is 0, it appends object bytes to the ring, increments field_4c of data_8018f5a0, updates best scores for the two linked objects, selects the next kind, and either inits the entity from the first object or sets flags on both objects. Otherwise it resets the hud indices, clears player field_a5, changes kind 0x13 to 0x11, clears entity fields and data_80190568 and calls init_block172_pool.

name: set_object_flags_and_hud_step_3
what the code shows: Sets field_cd of a to 1 and field_4c of data_8018f5a0 to 3. It sets field_27 and field_4f of b to 1, clears field_1b of b, and clears field_a5 of player_left and player_right.

name: advance_hud_step_and_reset_entity_fields
what the code shows: Calls func_80123bd4 for the entity with player_left and the object after it. It advances field_4a of data_8018f5a0 and clears its other fields and the entity's counters. It sets ready_flag and active_flag_2, clears field_01 and field_a5 of both players, sets their mode_flag_2 to 1, and clears data_80190568.

name: update_phase_or_init_object_pools
what the code shows: If data_8016e68b is 0, it calls func_8014ee5c with the focus object's kind on pass 0 (incrementing pass_index), else calls func_800100a4. If data_8016e68b is set and ready_flag is 0 it increments step_index and clears field_65. Otherwise it sets phase_index to 3, clears several index and state fields, sets active_flag to 1 and calls init_object_pools.

name: reset_hud_steps_or_call_fallback
what the code shows: If data_8016e68b is 0, calls func_80010e60. Otherwise it zeroes step_index and substep_index of data_8018f5a0 and several entity fields, sets active_flag to 1 and field_2c to 0xff, and clears field_01 of player_left and player_right.

name: set_winner_by_health
what the code shows: If state->field_80 is 0, compares the two players' health. It sets field_4c to 3 when equal, else 1 or 2 for the higher side, and stores that player's kind in field_8f.

name: init_entity_from_other_object

name: start_fade_command_2a01_0800_if_idle

name: spawn_position_table_objects_and_list_objects
