name: play_sound_and_reset_round_state
what the code shows: Calls func_80155f30, plays sound 0x323 at object, clears field_69 and round_count, and in versus mode for the non-selected side decrements field_1a1 (clearing field_19f if bit 0x80 set). It restores facing_side from saved_facing, clears field_170, sets field_292 to 0x20, then calls func_8012fe60, func_80131468 or func_801312b8 depending on mode_flag_2, func_8012f970 and input_bits_2 bit 0x4000.

name: call_state_2_handler_then_bound_x
what the code shows: Clears field_16a, calls the handler in table_801719f4 indexed by state_2, then calls func_80130b10 (which keeps pos_x inside the stage bounds).

name: call_state_3_table_function
what the code shows: Calls the handler in table_80171a00 indexed by state_3.

name: start_hit_reaction_by_hit_type
what the code shows: If a kind 10 object has kind10_flag set, it clears the flag and calls func_80136ed0 or func_80136e90 by side, then func_801372c8. It clears several object fields, increments state_3 and calls set_side_field_0d. When hit_type is 0xff it calls func_8012c7b4. Otherwise it updates versus fields, increments round_count, calls func_80138be4 and clears other's fields. It may set config field_75 with effect_request 8 and func_80155d4c, then picks a handler by hit_type: func_8012c5cc, func_8012c6a4, func_8012c72c, func_8012cc00, or the pairs_80170074 path that sets pair_value and field_60 and calls func_801308c4.

name: start_hit_sequence_from_pairs_table
what the code shows: Loads pair_value and field_60 from pairs_80170074 at the object's hit_type. Then it calls func_8012ca04 for hit_type 0x14 or 0x16, func_8012cb3c for 0x15 or 0x17, and for 0xb it sets active_state 0xff, increments field_69 and calls func_801308c4 with pair_value. Otherwise it does the same and, when field_60 is 2, calls func_8012c990 for 0xc, func_8012cac8 for 0xd or func_8012cc6c for 0x11, else func_801308c4 with pair_value.

name: set_hit_sequence_by_hit_type_and_move_other
what the code shows: Copies saved_facing into facing_side, clears field_60 and countdown. Picks a sequence index from field_62 capped at 2, plus 7 if field_157 is nonzero, plus 1 if hit_type is 8 or 0, else plus 4, and calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2. Then calls move_other_by_kind_table_on_hit, and calls func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0.

name: start_hit_sequence_base_7_or_4
what the code shows: Clears field_60 and countdown, copies saved_facing to facing_side, and calls func_801308c4 with index 7 (or 4 when field_157 is 0) plus field_62 capped at 2. Then it calls func_80131e88 and, if field_6b is 0, func_8012cca8.

name: set_sequence_from_hit_type_base_and_capped_step
what the code shows: Clears field_60, countdown and field_157, copies saved_facing into facing_side. Calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2 with index 1 (4 if hit_type is 0x18) plus field_62 capped at 2, then calls func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0.

name: select_sequence_by_action_timer_and_active_state
what the code shows: If action_timer is nonzero, calls func_8012c92c and returns. Otherwise copies saved_facing into facing_side. If active_state is nonzero, it sets field_60 to 3 and active_state to 0xff, calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2 with index 0x12, then calls func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0. If active_state is 0, it sets field_60 to 1 and clears countdown. Then, if mode_flag_2 is nonzero, it calls func_8012c89c. Otherwise it calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2 with index 0xc, or 0xe when field_157 is nonzero.

name: set_sequence_c_or_e_by_other_field_flag
what the code shows: Clears field_157, then sets index 0xc, or 0xe (and sets field_157 to 1) if the other object has active_state 0 and nonzero field_157. Calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2 with the index, then func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0.

name: init_fixed_sequence_c_and_clear_counters
what the code shows: Sets field_60 to 5, field_62 to 10, clears countdown and field_157, copies saved_facing into facing_side. Calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2 with index 0xc, then func_8012cca8 if field_6b is 0.

name: start_sequence_with_variant_zero_spawns_once
what the code shows: On first call (done_flag 0) it sets done_flag, spawns two counted objects (variant 0), plays sound 0x321 at the object and calls store_image_row_for_hit_type. Always sets field_15b to 1 and sets sequence 0x13 with set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2.

name: update_hit_reaction_type_16_sound_spawn
what the code shows: If active_state is nonzero it sets active_state 0xff, pair_value 0x13, field_60 2, increments field_69 and calls func_8012c990. Otherwise it spawns once via func_80152b40 (done_flag), plays sound 0x321, calls func_801376b8 and then func_8012c72c if hit_type is 0x16 else func_8012c5cc.

name: start_sequence_with_variant_two_spawns_once
what the code shows: On first call (once_flag_2 0) it sets it, spawns two counted objects (variant 2) and plays sound 0x321. Always sets field_15b to 1, calls store_image_row_for_hit_type and sets sequence 0x13.

name: update_hit_reaction_type_17_sound_spawn
what the code shows: If active_state is nonzero it sets active_state 0xff, pair_value 0x13, field_60 2, increments field_69 and calls func_8012cac8. Otherwise it once calls func_80152c34 and plays sound 0x321, sets field_15b to 1 and calls func_8012c72c if hit_type is 0x17 else func_8012c5cc.

name: start_hit_reaction_with_three_spawns
what the code shows: If active_state is 0 it calls func_8012c72c. Otherwise it sets pair_value 0x21 and field_60 2, calls func_80152d28, sets flag_25a_set to 1 and calls func_801308c4 with 0x21.

name: spawn_three_objects_and_set_sequence_x21
what the code shows: Spawns three objects with variant 4, sets flag_25a_set to 1 and sets sequence 0x21 with set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2.

Subtracts a step from field_6b (adds 0xff); when it goes negative advances state_2, clears state_3, field_24e and field_6b and calls func_8012ce5c. Otherwise may call func_8012f0e0 if the other's field_7e is set, sets field_16c from bytes_801700b0, and either bumps image_row by 4 or calls store_image_row_for_hit_type.
Calls the handler indexed by object->field_60 from a table.

name: call_state_3_table_function_2
what the code shows: Calls the function at index state_3 of table_80171a20 with the object.

name: advance_state_3_play_sound_and_step
what the code shows: Increments state_3, then calls func_8012d0bc (a side sound) and func_8012cf1c with object.

name: update_table_step_with_input_branches
what the code shows: Applies a table step to pos_x; when it ends, advances state_3 and clears flags, else stores the image row. Then depending on health, hit_type and input bits it forces sequence 0x1b with state_3 3, calls a meter action, updates the sequence, or sets field_60/field_157 and sequence 0xc or 0xe.

name: set_state_1_1_2_0_or_enter_state_1_6
what the code shows: If health is negative, calls enter_state_1_6_and_set_sequence. Otherwise sets state bytes to 1,1,2,0 and clears field_15b and step_applied_flag.

name: set_state_3_two_if_step_done
what the code shows: Calls func_8012eff8 on the object and, if it returns nonzero, sets state_3 to 2.

name: play_side_sound_0
what the code shows: Calls play_side_sound_at(object, object->side, 0).

name: play_side_sound_1
what the code shows: Calls play_side_sound_at(object, object->side, 1).

name: call_state_3_table_function_3
what the code shows: Calls the function at index state_3 of table_80171a20 with the object.

name: advance_state_3_and_call_step
what the code shows: Increments state_3, then calls func_8012d170 with object.

name: update_table_step_then_choose_sequence_c_or_e
what the code shows: Applies a table step to pos_x. If that ends, it increments state_3, flips facing_side from facing_flag and calls func_8012d394. Otherwise, depending on negative health, mode_flag_2 and input bit 0x2000, it sets a sequence 0xc or 0xe by side or calls update_sequence.

name: set_sequence_c_or_e_by_pressed_bits
what the code shows: If pressed_bits is 0 it calls func_801308c4 with index 0xc. Otherwise it increments field_157, clears action_timer and calls func_801308c4 with index 0xe.

name: call_meter_action_or_default_sequence
what the code shows: If meter is at least 0x30, health is non-negative and field_221 is nonzero, calls func_801303a0; otherwise calls func_8012d310.

name: set_sequence_by_action_timer_and_other
what the code shows: Clears field_157. If action_timer is nonzero it calls func_801308c4 with 0xc. Otherwise, if the other object has active_state 0 and nonzero field_157, it increments field_157 and uses index 0xe. It then calls func_801308c4 with the index.

name: set_state_1_1_2_0_or_enter_state_1_6_2
what the code shows: If health is negative, calls enter_state_1_6_and_set_sequence. Otherwise sets state bytes to 1,1,2,0 and clears field_15b and step_applied_flag.

name: call_state_3_table_function_4
what the code shows: Calls the function at index state_3 of table_80171a20 with the object.

name: advance_state_3_and_start_hit_reaction
what the code shows: Increments state_3, clears active_flag_3 and field_157, and calls func_8012ee7c, sets active_state to 0xff, and calls func_801376b8. If field_243 is nonzero it calls func_8012c494, then either sets vec_table_index to 6 and calls func_8012ee7c again (when field_15b is 0) or calls func_80141f28(object, 3) and func_8012d0e0 (which plays side sound 1). If field_243 is zero it calls func_8012d0e0. It then calls func_80148b60 when field_163 is nonzero, and finally func_8012d4e4.

name: update_airborne_fall_and_land
what the code shows: Calls func_80130184 to move the object. While it is still above ground it calls func_801376b8 and, depending on hit_type, vel_y, health and the other object, calls update_sequence or sets state_3 to 6 with sequence 0x18. On landing it increments state_3, plays sounds via func_80120a30, resets active_state, sets countdown to 4 and pos_y to ground_y, and calls func_80131df8, set_side_flag, clears flags and calls func_8012d7e4.

name: update_countdown_hit_type_sequence
what the code shows: Decrements countdown. While it is nonzero, it calls update_sequence or changes state_3 and the sequence depending on hit_type, vel_y, the other's field_7e and health. At zero it sets active_state to 0xff, increments state_3, calls func_8012ef24 and sets sequence entry 0x15 via func_801308c4.

name: choose_recovery_sequence_or_state
what the code shows: If mode_flag_2 is 0, or if kind, field_163, hit_flag, health, config mode flags, func_8012f56c or func_8014a170 fail the checks, it sets sequence entry 0x14 via func_801308c4. Otherwise it sets state_0 to 1, state_2 to 7, and clears other state and flags. It sets active_flag_3 to 1, or 0 when kind is 0xf.

name: update_fall_and_land_second_variant
what the code shows: Calls func_80130184 to move the object; while it returns nonzero it calls update_sequence. Otherwise it increments state_3, calls func_80131d68, clears active_state, sets countdown to 8 and pos_y to ground_y, calls func_801308c4 with 0x16 and func_80120a30 with arguments depending on the sign of health.

name: count_down_then_advance_or_enter_state_1_6
what the code shows: Decrements countdown. If nonzero, calls update_sequence. At zero, enters state 1,6 if health is negative, else increments state_3 and sets sequence 0x19.

Updates the sequence while step_flags is non-negative. At the end, if field_163 is 0 it sets state bytes 1,1,2,0; otherwise it sets state bytes 1,0,9,0, resets counters, adds round score to the other side, plays a sound, sets countdown from a table chosen by random byte and kind, and sets sequence 0x1a.

name: update_airborne_or_land
what the code shows: Calls func_80130184 (applies velocity and acceleration). If it returns nonzero, it calls update_sequence. Otherwise it sets state_0..3 to 1,1,2,0, clears field_15b, step_applied_flag and active_state, sets pos_y to ground_y with the fraction cleared, and calls func_801209c4.

name: move_by_vel_x_then_return_to_state_1_1_2_0
what the code shows: While step_flags is non-negative or countdown is nonzero after decrement, it adds vel_x to the position word and updates the sequence. Otherwise it sets state bytes 1,1,2,0, clears flags, and either enters state 1,6 on negative health or sets field_157 and restores facing_side from saved_facing.

name: count_down_then_set_state_3_to_5
what the code shows: Decrements countdown. At zero it sets state_3 to 5, clears flag_166_set, and calls func_8012f4dc if health is negative, else func_801308c4 with 0x19.

name: enter_state_1_8_if_check_passes
what the code shows: If hit_flag is 0, it calls func_8013cac8(object, 0xf, 0xd). If that is 0, it calls func_8012dde4. Otherwise, when func_80141c4c returns nonzero, it sets state bytes to 1,8,0,0, clears state_change_flag and calls func_80142b3c.

name: enter_state_1_8_if_kind_6_and_ready
what the code shows: If kind is 6 and func_8013cac8(object, 0xe, 8) returns nonzero and func_80141c4c returns nonzero, sets state bytes to 1,8,0,0, sets state_change_flag to 1 and calls func_80142b3c.

name: call_state_3_table_function_5
what the code shows: Calls the function at index state_3 of table_80171a20 with the object.

name: start_jump_with_horizontal_velocity_by_facing
what the code shows: Sets variant_index and active_state to 0xff, vel_y 0x10000, accel_y -0x6800, clears countdown and accel_x, increments state_3, and sets vel_x to -0x60000 or 0x60000 by facing_flag.

name: apply_push_step_then_update_air_move
what the code shows: Clears step_applied_flag. If bound_push_flag is set and apply_table_step_to_pos_x returns nonzero, it increments state_3. In all cases it then calls update_air_move_and_land.

name: update_air_move_and_land
what the code shows: Calls func_80130184 to move the object. If it reports pos_y above ground_y, it calls update_sequence, first setting state bytes to 1,0,3,1 and clearing active_flag_3 when step_flags is negative. Otherwise it lands: sets pos_y to ground_y, state bytes 1,0,3,2, clears active_flag_3 and active_state, calls func_801209c4, then func_8012fe60 or set_sequence_by_side with 0x11.

name: call_state_3_handler_from_table_a
what the code shows: Calls the handler indexed by object->state_3 from a handler table.

name: update_airborne_or_bounce_land
what the code shows: Calls func_80130184 to move the object. While airborne it calls update_sequence if the earlier vel_y was negative. On landing it sets state_3 to 7, countdown to 4, snaps pos_y to ground_y, sets facing_side and vel_x of ±0x60000 from the sign of vel_x, and sets sequence 0x1f.

name: call_state_3_handler_from_table_b
what the code shows: Calls the handler indexed by object->state_3 from a handler table.

name: advance_state_3_and_call_step_2
what the code shows: Increments state_3 and calls func_8012d170.

Applies a table step to pos_x. If that ends, it increments state_3, flips facing_side and calls func_8012e334 and returns. Otherwise it updates the sequence or picks state 0xc, and then sets sequence 0xc or 0xe (also incrementing field_157 and clearing action_timer and field_60 when pressed_bits has 0x4000) via set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2.

name: select_sequence_by_meter_or_other_field
what the code shows: If meter >= 0x30, health >= 0 and field_221 is set, calls func_801303a0 and returns. Otherwise clears field_157 and calls func_801308c4 with 0xc, or with 0xe (incrementing field_157) when action_timer is zero, the other object has active_state 0 and nonzero field_157.

name: set_state_1_1_2_0_clear_action_timer
what the code shows: If health is negative, calls enter_state_1_6_and_set_sequence. Otherwise sets state bytes to 1,1,2,0 and clears field_15b, step_applied_flag and action_timer.

name: reset_round_counters_and_choose_next_state
what the code shows: Calls add_round_score_to_other_side, clears round_count and several counters and hit counts, decrements field_1a1 in versus mode for the non-selected side, sets other_state_code 5 and restores facing_side from saved_facing. Then calls func_8012e4c4 if mode_flag_2 is set, else picks a state function from input (pressed bytes, button input, bit 0x4000, or default).

name: clear_script_bytes_and_select_reset_transition
what the code shows: Clears field_207, field_208 and field_209, calls func_8014cbf8 if field_20c is nonzero, then calls func_80149fc4 if func_80149d48 is nonzero, else func_801312b8 when field_157 is 0, else func_80131468.

name: call_scratch_by_side_then_bound_pos
what the code shows: Calls one of four scratch_call functions chosen by side and mode_flag_2. If status_flag is 0 it then calls func_80130b10.

name: attach_object_to_other_frame_box
what the code shows: Clears several flags and timers, once awards a score to the other object and sets its effect_request to 8, counts down countdown with input checks, and places the object relative to the other's frame box from per-kind box tables. It sets facing_side and sequence from the box, resets step_flags and calls push_both_objects_inside_bounds.

name: call_scratch_function_by_side
what the code shows: Calls the function at scratchpad slot 0x5c if side is 0, else the one at slot 0x10c, passing the object.

name: call_handler_by_kind_and_side
what the code shows: If kind is 2, 6, 0xc, 0xe, 0x11, 0x13 or 0x14, it calls scratch_call_98 for side 0 or scratch_call_148 otherwise. For other kinds it calls func_8012e984.

name: call_handler_by_state_2
what the code shows: Calls the handler in handlers_1a80 indexed by state_2.

name: advance_state_2_and_restore_facing
what the code shows: Increments state_2, copies saved_facing to facing_side and calls set_sequence_by_side with 0.

name: advance_state_2_unless_hold_flag
what the code shows: If game_state.config->hold_flag is 0, increments state_2. Then calls update_sequence.

name: start_countdown_and_set_sequence
what the code shows: Sets countdown to 0x78 and increments state_2. It calls set_sequence_by_side with 0x28, or 0x29 if config->table_index is nonzero.

name: tick_countdown_set_side_bit
what the code shows: If countdown is nonzero, decrements it. When it reaches 0 it sets the bit for the object's side in config->side_bits. It calls update_sequence in either case.

name: set_side_bit_in_game_state
what the code shows: Sets bit (1 << object->side) in game_state.field_4b.

name: update_or_reset_object_by_kind
what the code shows: If config->mode_flag_c is nonzero, then for kinds 3, 4, 5, 8, 17, 18, 19 it calls update_sequence while step_flags is nonnegative. Other kinds call a scratchpad function by side. In the other cases it sets state_0 to 1, clears state_1 to state_3 and sets sequence 0.

name: call_state_2_handler_1a90_then_bound_x
what the code shows: Calls the handler in handlers_1a90 indexed by state_2, then calls func_80130b10.

name: update_airborne_or_land_with_speed
what the code shows: If func_80130184 returns 0 (the object is at or below ground_y), it lands: it sets state_2, snaps pos_y to ground_y, resets flags and counters, sets countdown from a table, calls set_side_flag, func_80130af0 and func_801209c4, sets vel_x from a per-kind speed with sign by facing, and calls set_sequence_by_side. Otherwise it calls update_sequence and func_801376b8.

name: update_move_until_countdown_expires
what the code shows: If step_flags is negative and countdown minus 0x100 goes negative, it restores facing_side, clears flags and calls func_801312b8. Otherwise it adds vel_x to the position word if direction_index is nonzero and calls update_sequence.

name: count_down_then_set_state_2
what the code shows: Decrements countdown, and sets state_2 to 1 if its old low byte was 0. Then calls update_sequence.

name: set_motion_from_vec_table
what the code shows: Selects a vec table by kind (0xd40 mask), field_295 and field_69, stores a pointer to entry field_63&0x3f in game_state.cursor, and calls func_8012efa4 and func_8012efcc to set the object's velocity and acceleration from it.

name: set_velocity_from_table
what the code shows: Chooses a table of Vec4 (a different one if kind & 0xd40) and an index from field_63 & 0x3f (0 if field_295 is nonzero). It sets vel_x and accel_x from the entry (negated if facing_flag is 0) and vel_y and accel_y from it.

name: set_x_velocity_from_entry
what the code shows: Sets vel_x and accel_x from entry's a and b, both negated if facing_flag is 0.

name: set_y_motion_from_entry
what the code shows: Sets object->vel_y to entry->c and accel_y to entry->d.

name: is_no_horizontal_input
what the code shows: Returns 1 if neither bit 0x8000 nor bit 0x2000 of object->input_bits_2 is set, else 0.

name: apply_table_step_to_pos_x
what the code shows: Clears step_applied_flag; when countdown is odd, bound_push_flag and active_state are 0 it calls func_80148e84. Reads a delta from table_80170244 by field_62 and countdown; if its 0x80 bit is clear it increments countdown, sets step_applied_flag, flips sign by facing_flag, doubles if health negative, adds to pos_x and returns 0, else returns 1.

name: move_pos_x_by_countdown_parity
what the code shows: Calls call_handler_by_mode_flag_2, clears step_applied_flag. If countdown is odd it calls func_80148e84 when bound_push_flag and active_state are 0. Otherwise it sets step_applied_flag and adds to pos_x a step of ±1 (doubled if health is negative) and then ±3 depending on facing_side and field_6b bit 0.

name: call_handler_by_mode_flag_2
what the code shows: If field_60 is 1, field_6b is nonzero and frame->handler_index is nonzero, it calls func_8012d310 when mode_flag_2 is nonzero, else func_8012f230.

name: update_sequence_or_select_by_input_bits
what the code shows: If bit 0x2000 of input_bits_2 is clear, calls update_sequence. Otherwise clears field_157 and, depending on action_timer and bit 0x4000, calls func_8012d264 or func_801308c4 with 0xc, or sets field_157 to 1 and calls it with 0xe.

name: is_pushing_toward_bound_in_air
what the code shows: For kind 4, 0x12 or 7, when pos_y is more than 0x20 above ground_y, variant_index is nonzero and input_bits_2 bit 0x4000 is clear, it compares bound_push_flag with the sign of the high half of vel_x and returns the matching input_bits bit (0x8000 or 0x2000); otherwise returns 0.

name: start_wall_bounce_sequence
what the code shows: Sets state_3 to 5, plays sound 0x314 at the object, sets facing_side to 1 unless bound_push_flag equals 1, then calls set_sequence_by_side with 0x30.

name: set_state_3_4_and_sequence
what the code shows: Sets state_3 to 4 and calls set_sequence_by_side with 0x1c.

name: start_health_comparison_sequence
what the code shows: Returns 0 if config mode_flag_a is 0. Otherwise sets state_0=1, state_3=3, state_1=state_2=0, sets facing_side from saved_facing (flipped for kind 2), picks a sequence index (0x29 equal health, 0x23 or 0x27 for kind 0xd if the object has more health, 0x28 if less), calls set_sequence_by_side and returns 1.

name: enter_state_1_6_and_set_sequence
what the code shows: Sets state bytes to 1,6,0,0, clears done_flag, once_flag_2 and flag_25a_set, calls set_side_flag, stores object->other in game_state.other_object, calls func_80155f30 if its field_167 is below 0xb, then calls func_801308c4 with 0x1b.

name: is_other_object_state_0_and_1_six_one
what the code shows: Stores object->other in game_state.other_object and returns whether its first two state bytes read as the 16-bit value 0x601.

name: set_win_state_and_store_result_byte
what the code shows: Sets state_0=1, state_1=4, state_2=0, state_3=0. If health is 0x90 it increments repeat_count and sets bit 0x80 of field_167. Then stores field_167 into the byte at offset 0xcf plus win_count.

name: clear_flag_if_second_flag_set
what the code shows: Clears object->field_251 if both field_251 and field_d8 are nonzero.

name: is_button_4000_held_or_other_flag
what the code shows: Returns 1 if bit 0x4000 of input_bits_2 is set, or if versus_flag is set, game_state.mode differs from side+1, hit_count_2 is nonzero and the other object's field_157 is nonzero; else 0.

name: set_state_1_0_1_0_sequence_7
what the code shows: Sets state_0=1, state_1=0, state_2=1, state_3=0, clears field_157 and calls set_sequence_by_side with 7.

name: is_button_4000_pressed
what the code shows: Returns 1 if versus_flag is set, mode differs from side+1, hit_count_2 is nonzero, the other's field_157 is nonzero and field_15b is 0. Otherwise returns whether bit 0x4000 is set in pressed_bits (if action_timer is nonzero) or input_bits_2.

name: set_state_1_0_1_2_sequence_4
what the code shows: Sets state_0=1, state_1=0, state_2=1, state_3=2, clears field_157 and calls set_sequence_by_side with 4.

name: is_single_horizontal_input_held
what the code shows: Returns 1 if field_7e is 0 and the 0x8000/0x2000 bits of input_bits_2 are exactly one of them (0x8000 or 0x2000); else 0.

name: is_only_horizontal_input_held
what the code shows: Returns 1 if field_7e is 0 and input_bits_2 equals exactly 0x8000 or 0x2000; else 0.

name: start_move_state_1_0_2_1_with_sequence_by_input
what the code shows: Sets state bytes to 1,0,2,1, calls set_vel_x_from_motion_speed_table, then calls set_sequence_by_side with 2 if input_bits_2 has 0x8000, else 3.

name: is_facing_differs_from_saved
what the code shows: Returns 1 if field_7e is 0 and saved_facing differs from facing_side; else 0.

name: set_win_state_or_state_4_sequence
what the code shows: If game_state.field_4d is nonzero it calls set_win_or_lose_state_by_health. Otherwise if func_8012f56c is true it calls set_win_state_and_store_result_byte; else it sets state bytes 1,0,4 with state_3 0 or 1 according to field_157, restores facing_side from saved_facing and sets sequence 10 or 13 by side.

name: find_nearby_enemy_and_get_flag
what the code shows: Clears data_80186000. If object->field_7e is 0, calls find_nearby_enemy_unit_set_flag and returns data_80186000; otherwise returns 0.

name: find_nearby_enemy_unit_set_flag
what the code shows: Loops over 16 Unit records at units_2c20 (stride 0xc0), looking for an active one without status bit 0x80, with other team_id and within 0x50 pos_x distance. On a match it may set field_24e and field_251 depending on input_word bit 0x2000 and field_d8, sets data_80186000 to 1 and returns. If none, sets data_80186000 to the result of func_8012faf8.

name: check_condition_with_other
what the code shows: Returns 0 or 1 from a series of checks on the object, the other object, game_state versus_flag and mode, input_word bits and config masks. It may increment hit_count_2 and set field_24e and field_251, and calls func_8012fd80 on the pair.

name: check_wide_box_in_range_over_sequence
what the code shows: Walks b's sequence steps; for each step with a nonzero wide box, computes the horizontal distance between a and the box origin (flipped by facing_side) and returns 2 if it is within the box endpoint plus 0x58. Returns 0 at once if frame field_0c has bit 0x80, else 1 when the sequence ends without a match.

name: enter_state_2_6_by_button_input
what the code shows: Sets facing_side from saved_facing. If the versus conditions hold with the other's field_157 set, or action_timer is 0 and input_bits_2 bit 0x4000 is set, sets field_157=1, state_3=2 and sequence 0x18; otherwise field_157=0, state_3=0 and sequence 0x15. Sets state_0=1, state_1=0, state_2=6.

name: set_win_or_lose_state_by_health
what the code shows: Compares health with the other object's: if the other's is greater or equal sets state_1=5, otherwise state_1=4, sets field_167 and the win_count slot (and increments repeat_count when health is 0x90). Clears state_2, state_3, field_7e, cursor timers, frame_count and field_180, then calls set_sequence_by_side with 0.

name: set_vel_x_from_motion_speed_table
what the code shows: Sets variant_index to 1 if bit 0x8000 of input_bits_2 is clear, else 0, then sets vel_x to motion_speed_table[kind*2+variant_index], negated when facing_side is nonzero.

name: set_motion_from_table
what the code shows: Chooses an index 0, 2 or 3 from field_130 bits (when field_cd is 0) or from field_21a (otherwise). Sets vel_y, accel_y, vel_x and accel_x from motion_table[kind][index], negating the x values if field_0b is nonzero.

name: apply_velocity_and_check_ground
what the code shows: Adds vel_x to the 32-bit x position word and accel_x to vel_x. It subtracts vel_y from the y position word and adds accel_y to vel_y. It returns whether pos_y is at most ground_y.

name: apply_vel_x_and_check_input_bit
what the code shows: Calls func_8012f838 if the input_bits_2 bit 0x8000 (variant_index nonzero) or 0x2000 (variant_index zero) is set, then adds vel_x to the 32-bit position word.

name: is_input_bit_1000_held
what the code shows: Returns 0 if field_7e is nonzero. Otherwise returns 1 if bit 0x1000 of field_130 is set, else 0.

name: enter_state_1_3_with_input_variant_and_sequence
what the code shows: Sets state_0..state_3 to 1,0,3,0, clears field_157 and calls set_motion_from_table. Sets variant_index to 1 if input_bits_2 bit 0x8000 is set, else 0xff if bit 0x2000 is set, else 0. Then calls set_sequence_by_side with index 0x10.

name: call_scratch_fn_by_side_and_mode
what the code shows: Calls func_80130ec0, then calls one of four scratch functions chosen by side and by whether mode_flag_2 is zero.

name: call_by_other_active_state_and_side
what the code shows: Sets effect_request to 4, field_256 and table_flag to 1, calls func_80141f28 with -0x30, then calls one of four scratch functions chosen by whether the other object's active_state is nonzero and by side.

name: get_pressed_low_byte
what the code shows: Returns the low byte of object->pressed_bits as a u16.

name: set_state_1_0_5_and_read_input_direction
what the code shows: Sets state bytes to 1,0,5,0, copies saved_facing into facing_side when field_7e is 0, calls func_80142c04, clears active_flag and calls func_80130504. It sets field_157 and input_dir_0 to 2 or 0 from func_8012f618, then calls func_8012b45c.

name: set_direction_from_pressed_bits
what the code shows: Calls func_8013054c and stores the first byte of its result in direction_index and the second in input_dir_second.

name: get_direction_pair_from_pressed_bits
what the code shows: Returns a pair of bytes chosen by the first set bit of pressed_bits in priority order (0x80, 0x10, 0x4, 0x40, 0x20, 0x8, 0x1, 0x2): first is 0, 2 or 4 and second is 0 or 2; both 0 when none is set.

name: push_ring_value_then_call_scratch_fn_by_side
what the code shows: Calls push_object_value_to_side_ring, sets field_262 to 0x10. If field_267 is 0, clears field_25c and calls scratch_fn_left for side 0 or scratch_fn_right otherwise.

name: set_sequence_by_side
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence to entry index of seqs_60_left (side 0) or seqs_110_right, loads step_timer and step_flags from it, sets sequence_changed_flag to 1, sets frame from frames plus frame_index, and copies frame->field_0d to field_4a.

name: set_sequence_entry
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence to the given entry, loads step_timer and step_flags, sets sequence_changed_flag to 1. If field_08 is 0 or 8 it also sets frame and field_4a from the frame; otherwise it sets field_4a to 0.

name: set_sequence_from_table_5
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence to table[index] (index as s16), loads step_timer and step_flags, sets sequence_changed_flag to 1. If field_08 is 0 or 8 it sets frame and field_4a from the frame; otherwise field_4a is 0.

name: set_sequence_by_side_and_mode
what the code shows: Sets object->sequence from sequences_left/right (field_cd 0) or seqs_9c_left/seqs_14c_right by side at the index. It loads step_timer and step_flags, sets sequence_changed_flag to 1, sets frame and field_4a, and calls func_80131020.

name: set_sequence_by_side_and_mode_2
what the code shows: Chooses a sequence entry by index from one of four tables depending on field_295 (nonzero or not) and side. Sets sequence_changed_flag if the entry differs from the current one, then loads sequence, step_timer, step_flags, frame and field_4a.

name: clamp_pos_x_to_bounds_and_push_other
what the code shows: Clears bound_push_flag and keeps pos_x inside the stage bounds using half_width and box_margin, setting bound_push_flag to 1 (left) or 2 (right). When state is 0x101 and near the other object, it may shift the other's pos_x by the same correction.

name: push_both_objects_inside_bounds
what the code shows: Finds the left and right object of the pair. If the left one is beyond the left bound or the right one beyond the 0x180 bound (using field_154 and box_margin[0]), shifts the pos_x of both objects and sets the other's field_164 to 1 or 2.

name: set_sequence_and_tables_from_direction
what the code shows: Calls func_80130ec0, takes half of direction_index and calls func_80141f28 with it (for kind 9 it manages field_225 with counter). Computes an index from half, input_dir_0 (adds 6, increments field_157) and input_dir_second (adds 3), calls func_801307e0 with it and sets kind_table_value and countdown_5 from per-kind tables.

name: reset_direction_and_action_fields
what the code shows: Clears field_278, dir_match_flag, field_157, active_flag and field_16a, sets dir_first and dir_second to 0xff, and calls func_80142c04.

name: advance_sequence_if_state_and_not_held
what the code shows: If field_7e is nonzero, state_0 is 1 and either state_2/3 pair is 0x0303 in the upper half or state_2 is 5, and sequence_hold_flag is 0, it calls advance_sequence.

name: advance_sequence_checked
what the code shows: Counts step_timer down; at zero moves the sequence to the loop_offset step (if step_flags negative) or the next step, sets sequence_changed_flag if it changed, and loads step_timer and step_flags. Sets frame and field_4a if field_08 is 0 or 8, otherwise field_4a is 0.

name: advance_sequence_with_key_rewind_and_hold
what the code shows: Reads a key word chosen by field_02 (data_801a696a or data_801a6976). Bit 1 decrements step_timer; bit 2 moves the sequence back one step and reloads timer and flags. When step_timer reaches 0 it advances the sequence (or loops via loop_offset) and updates variant_index_2.

name: reset_object_to_state_1_0_sequence_0
what the code shows: Calls swap_kind, set_sequence_by_side with 0, sets state bytes to 1,0,0,0, clears field_157, calls func_8013151c and func_80155f30, clears field_170, round_count and field_69, and in versus mode for the non-selected side decrements field_1a1 and clears field_19f if it goes negative.

name: reset_idle_or_kind_10_sequence
what the code shows: If mode_flag_2 is 0 and kind is 10, it calls func_801313bc with 0x30. Otherwise it calls func_801312b8.

name: reset_object_to_state_1_0_sequence_arg
what the code shows: Calls set_sequence_by_side with arg, sets state bytes to 1,0,0,0, clears field_157, calls func_8013151c and func_80155f30, clears field_170, round_count and field_69, and in versus mode decrements field_1a1 (clearing field_19f when negative).

name: reset_object_to_state_1_0_0_2_sequence_1
what the code shows: Calls swap_kind, sets state bytes to 1,0,0,2, sets field_157 to 1, calls func_8013151c and func_80155f30, clears field_170, round_count and field_69, handles the versus field_1a1 decrement, then calls set_sequence_by_side with 1.

name: reset_object_fields_2
what the code shows: Resets many fields of the object to 0 (and dir_first, dir_second, field_17e to 0xff), sets pos_y to ground_y with its fraction cleared, copies field_158 to field_0b, and clears a few more fields depending on field_7e of the object and of the other object, which it stores in game_state.other_object.

name: land_reset_fields_and_choose_next_state
what the code shows: Calls swap_kind, sets state bytes to 1,0,3,2, sets pos_y to ground_y and calls reset_object_fields_2. Then, depending on input and facing, calls an input-based state function, func_8012f8c4, or sets sequence 0x11 by side.

name: update_input_bits
what the code shows: If game_state.field_30 is nonzero, it either clears the object's input words (setting them to 0x4000 if data_801a6984[3] is set) when game_state.mode differs from side+1, or calls func_80131ab4. It swaps some direction bits of field_130 and field_150 when facing flags are set, then sets pressed_bits and released_bits from field_130 and field_132.

name: load_remapped_input
what the code shows: Picks a controller word into data_80185ff8 by field_02 and data_801a6984[0]. Remaps its low 8 bits through table_80185fd8 and table_8016e664, adds the high byte, and stores the result in field_130, field_c2 and field_150.

name: record_input_log
what the code shows: If input_log.index is below 0xffd, either appends a repeat count entry (last value with 0x200 set) when the current pad word equals the last one, or starts a new entry from the side's pad word, advancing input_log.index and updating input_log.last and flag.

name: replay_input_log
what the code shows: Reads a word from input_log.buf at input_log.index and stores it masked with 0xfdff in field_c2, field_130 and field_150. A bit 0x200 acts as a repeat flag using a counter. At index 0xffd or above, it clears the fields.

name: push_other_object_x_by_table
what the code shows: Loops up to 4 times: stops if func_80148e84 returns zero, otherwise adds table_80171b38[i] (negated if facing_side nonzero) to the pos_x of game_state.other_object.

name: push_other_object_x_by_table_2
what the code shows: Up to 4 times, while func_80148e84(object) is nonzero, adds table_80171b38[i] to game_state.other_object->pos_x, negated when object->field_0b is nonzero.

name: move_other_by_kind_table_on_hit
what the code shows: If hit_type is 0 and field_62 is at least 2, calls func_80146840 or func_80146864 by a random bit. On a hit it subtracts table_80171b48[kind].second from the other object's pos_y and adds .first (negated if facing_side nonzero) to its pos_x.

name: set_sequence_x28_if_state_7_0_1_and_active
what the code shows: If the first three state bytes equal 0x07,0x00,0x01 (state_0 to state_2), field_15a is 1, field_7e is 0 and active_flag is nonzero, clears active_flag and calls set_sequence_by_side_and_mode with index 0x28.

name: is_input_and_state_check_passed
what the code shows: Returns 0 if mode_flag_2 is nonzero or func_8013d0fc is false; otherwise returns whether func_801418bc is nonzero.

name: set_state_7_variant_from_input
what the code shows: Sets variant_index to 1 or 0xff by bit 0x8000 of input_bits_2, sets field_15a to 2, clears active_flag_3, sets state_0..3 to 1,0,7,0, and calls func_80132198.

name: reset_substate_and_set_direction_index
what the code shows: Clears substate_index, field_12d, step_count_2 and step_limit, sets facing_side from saved_facing, and sets direction_index to 0, 2 or 4 depending on bits 0xc0, 0x30 or neither in pressed_bits|released_bits.

name: play_frame_sound
what the code shows: If field_4a is nonzero, clears it and picks a sound table by data_801a8067, data_801a83fb, side and kind. It looks up the entry at the old field_4a and calls play_sound_at if the high byte is set, else play_side_sound_at.

name: enter_state_7_if_airborne_conditions
what the code shows: When mode_flag_2, table_column >= 0x1d, loop_counter is 0, an active or step_flags condition holds, linked_object_3 is 0 and pos_y is above ground_y-0x30, sets states (1,0,7,0), field_15a=4 and calls scratch_call_right or scratch_call_left by side.

name: init_hud_primitives
what the code shows: Initializes the HUD block: writes SetTile and SetPolyFT4 primitives with positions, colors and sizes for two buffers, health values, GetTPage values, table entries and strips. It finishes by calling func_80153088, init_strips and init_strips2.

name: init_strips
what the code shows: For each of 2x4 Strip1c entries in strips and in data_80190014, calls func_80136d1c and sets fields 10-12 to 0x80, field_16 to 0x1a, field_1a to 0x7f07 and field_04 to 0xe100001f. When game_state.field_42 is 0 it also sets field_18 to 0x80 and field_19 to 0. Then it sets field_14 to 0xc+m*0x10 for strips and 0x154-j*0x10 for data_80190014.

name: init_strips2
what the code shows: For each of 2x2 Strip1c entries in strips2 and data_80188e4c, calls func_80136d1c and sets fields 10-12 to 0x80, field_16 to 0, field_19 to 0xe0, field_1a to 0x7f07 and field_04 to 0xe100001f. Then it sets field_18 (0 and 0x10) and field_14 (0x78/0x88 for strips2, 0xd8/0xe8 for data_80188e4c) of each pair.

name: update_hud_bars_and_meters
what the code shows: Sets data_801ac870 and data_801ac878 from table_80172144 entries chosen by data_80171c5d and data_80171c5c, overridden by entries 12 and 11 when data_80171c5f and data_80171c5e are set. It then calls update_health_bars, func_80133108, func_80135858 and func_80135a10.

name: update_health_bars
what the code shows: Clamps field_5c of a and b to at least 0, and moves each field_5e by 1 toward it every fourth tick of game_state.field_32. It then fills two Bars records, 0x10 bytes apart, with values from these fields and constants 0x98 and 0xd8.

name: fill_meter_segments_for_both_objects
what the code shows: Fills a table of 16-byte entries at base with colour and size values for the meter segments of left and right objects (meter scaled by 3 when field_d8 is set), using data_80171c5c-5f as stage flags, and calls func_801336a0, func_801340e4, func_8013411c and func_80133848.

name: write_two_player_color_bytes_to_table
what the code shows: Unless a or b has field_165 set, writes byte color triples into the table at base for entry index (16 bytes per entry) at many offsets, with values depending on whether a->field_d8 and b->field_d8 are zero; also stores into data_80188d64/65/68/69.

name: update_meter_hud_primitives
what the code shows: If either object's field_165 is nonzero, it calls helper functions and writes color bytes and halfwords into the base entry for each object. It derives data_80188d44/48 from meter and field_255, and sets meter-segment colors that blink with game_state.tick_count bits 4 and 8.

name: write_player_color_bytes_to_table
what the code shows: Writes color bytes at entry index (16 bytes per entry) of base for offsets 0x8-0x6a, using player_left.field_d8 and player_right.field_d8 to choose 0 or 0x30; also stores into data_80188d64/65/68/69.

name: write_right_color_triplets_by_value
what the code shows: Unless player_right.field_165 is 1 with game_state.field_31 0, writes three-byte color triples into base at offsets 0xc8, 0xe8 and 0x108 plus index*16. The first two triples depend on data_80171c5c (0..2 or higher); the third is always 0x30,0x30,0.

name: write_left_color_triplets_by_value
what the code shows: Unless player_left.field_165 is 1 with game_state.field_31 0, writes three-byte color triples into base at offsets 0x128, 0x148 and 0x168 plus index*16. The first two depend on data_80171c5d (4..6 or other); the third is always 0x30,0x30,0.

name: set_three_byte_triples_in_first_group_row
what the code shows: Writes the bytes 0xf0,0xf0,0 at three places in base, at offsets 0xc8, 0xe8 and 0x108 plus index*16.

name: set_three_byte_triples_in_second_group_row
what the code shows: Writes the bytes 0xf0,0xf0,0 at three places in base, at offsets 0x128, 0x148 and 0x168 plus index*16.

name: set_left_halfwords_and_bump_counters
what the code shows: If player_left.field_d8 is nonzero, writes 0x30 as a halfword at offsets 0xd0, 0xf0, 0x110 of the entry index in base and increments data_80188d4c, data_80188d50 and data_80188d54.

name: set_right_halfwords_and_bump_counters
what the code shows: If player_right.field_d8 is nonzero, writes 0x30 as a halfword at offsets 0x130, 0x150, 0x170 of the entry index in base and increments data_80188d58, data_80188d5c and data_80188d60.

name: add_selector_hud_prims_and_strips
what the code shows: Returns early unless several globals allow it. It then adds many primitives with AddPrim from the player table base, entries chosen by the selector data_801a27d0, calls func_801347b4 seven times, runs effects and a data pointer function, adds strip primitives and finally calls queue_player_status_text_items.

name: update_bar_entry_and_add_prim
what the code shows: Clamps variant_index_2 to 0x90 and writes bar widths into the base table entry for table_index 0 or otherwise (doubled and clamped to 0x48 under a mode flag), calls AddPrim, then calls func_801347b4 with the sequence data_ptr and position.

name: select_meter_level_table_entry
what the code shows: Depending on a (3 for left, 2 for right), each player's meter range and b, sets data_80188d28 from entries of table_80188d08; when field_d8 is set, uses entry 2 or 6 if data_80171c5e or c5f is nonzero.

name: update_meter_animation_indices
what the code shows: For each player and meter range matching a and b, counts down a timer, steps an index in table_80188d08 by a direction and reloads the timer from a table, reversing direction at the ends of the range.

name: update_round_timer_display_cells
what the code shows: If versus_flag is set with a zero word at data_801a6984, or round_time has bit 0x80, sets fields in two Cell56 entries to fixed values. Otherwise converts round_time to digits with set_digits_from_number, writes the digits into tex_u fields, and sets tex_param values for time 0x63 or below 0x15 (blinking every 4 frames).

name: update_win_marker_strips
what the code shows: If data_80190474 is 1 and game_state.focus_object is set, stores field_167 into the bytes_d0 entry (win_count-1) of the left or right player by team_id, plays sound 0x34c at that player, converts the value (bit 7 → ((v&0x7f)<<2)|2, else v<<2) and calls func_80135c0c with two strips entries. If data_80190474 is 2, calls func_80135c0c with value 0x20 for each of the 4 entries per player whose bytes_d0 equals 8.

name: copy_table_pair_to_two_entries
what the code shows: Writes data_801721c8[index] to byte 0x18 and data_801721c8[index+1] to byte 0x19 of both a and b, and clears data_80190474.

name: set_wait_flag
what the code shows: Stores v in the wait_flag field of a.

name: queue_player_status_text_items
what the code shows: When data_8019032d is zero, depending on flags it queues text items via func_801519b4 for each player (by low nibble of a status byte, or via func_80156c80/func_80156bc8 when the byte is 4), or blinking messages by loop_counter bit 0x20 and mode.

name: set_capped_value_and_ot_indices
what the code shows: Sets capped_value from packed_value: if bit 0 is set, packed_value>>2 capped at 0x10, else 0. Calls the function in data_8017262c indexed by game_state.kind_index and copies three bytes of data_801725f0 for table_index into ot_index of data_801aa544[0..2], and the middle one into data_80190562.

name: call_kind_handlers_b_a_then_cam
what the code shows: Calls the three kind-handler routines in order: call_kind_handler_and_copy_fields_b, call_kind_handler_and_copy_fields_a, then call_cam_kind_handler_and_save_pos.

name: call_kind_handlers_b_cam_then_a
what the code shows: Calls call_kind_handler_and_copy_fields_b, then call_cam_kind_handler_and_save_pos, then call_kind_handler_and_copy_fields_a.

name: call_kind_handler_and_copy_fields_a
what the code shows: Calls the function in data_801723c0 indexed by game_state.kind_index with data_801aa544, then copies values among data_801aa5xx fields, and computes data_801aa594 from data_801aa598 plus two multiples of data_801aa58c and data_801aa58e.

name: init_sprite_once_with_mode_y
what the code shows: Calls func_801361fc on the sprite with x 0x1c0 and y 0x100 if game_state.field_0a is 6, else 0. Then if sprite->pending is nonzero, clears it and increments sprite->count.

name: init_sprite_at_1c0_zero
what the code shows: Calls func_801361a4 with the sprite, x 0x1c0 and y 0.

name: init_sprite_counted
what the code shows: Calls func_801361fc to initialize the sprite at x, y. If pending is nonzero it clears it and increments count.

name: init_sprite_position
what the code shows: Initializes a Sprite at position x, y. It writes x and y to three field pairs, stores masked (0x1ff) values and offsets in game_state, sets field_40 to field_46 to -1, zeroes the other fields and sets pending to 0xff.

name: call_kind_handler_and_copy_fields_b
what the code shows: Calls the function in data_80172410 indexed by game_state.kind_index with data_801aa5d4, then copies data_801aa5f6 to data_801aa5fe and data_801aa5fa to data_801aa602.

name: init_sprite_wide_and_consume_pending
what the code shows: Calls init_sprite_position_wide with x 0x1c0 and y 0. If sprite->pending is nonzero, clears it, increments count, and sets field_4a to 0x200 when game_state.field_0a is 6.

name: init_sprite_3ff_and_count_pending
what the code shows: Calls func_80136404 on the sprite with x 0x1c0, y 0. If sprite->pending is nonzero, clears it and increments sprite->count.

name: update_camera_if_active
what the code shows: If the sprite's active_flag is nonzero and game_state.side_bits_2 is zero, calls func_801364a0 and func_80136744 on it.

name: init_sprite_position_wide
what the code shows: Initializes a Sprite at x, y like func_801361fc but with 0x3ff masks and different game_state fields. It sets field_40 to 0x10, field_44 to 0x100, field_46 to 0x280, zeroes the others and sets pending to 0xff.

name: update_camera_x_from_player_span
what the code shows: Computes the x span of player_left and player_right from pos_x ± half_width (using only the other player's span if one has status_flag bit 7 set and field_261 zero). Then moves the camera (sprite cast to Cam) by calling func_80136668 or func_801366d4 with an amount, or set_cam_pos_x with field_22, depending on span width and edges relative to field_22.

name: move_cam_right
what the code shows: Clamps step to at most 5, adds it to cam->pos_x, then calls func_80136898 with pos_x limited to max_x.

name: move_cam_left
what the code shows: Negates step and clamps it to at most 5, subtracts it from cam->pos_x, then calls func_80136898 with pos_x limited to at least min_x.

name: update_cam_y_toward_players

name: update_object_motion_unless_paused

name: advance_state_2_set_countdown_high_and_sequence

what the code shows: Subtracts 0x100 from object->countdown. When its high byte becomes zero, sets active_count to 1, state_0 to 1 and state_1 to state_3 to 0.

name: call_state_2_handler_2684_unless_paused
what the code shows: Unless a pause flag is set, it calls the handler in handlers_2684 indexed by state_2. Then it calls func_8011ffdc if bits 0x92 of (countdown >> 8) are set.

name: advance_state_2_set_countdown_bits_and_sequence
what the code shows: Increments state_2, sets countdown to its low byte ORed with 0x1800, then calls advance_sequence_checked.

name: tick_countdown_then_set_state_0_to_3
what the code shows: Subtracts 0x100 from the 16-bit countdown. If it goes negative, sets state_0 to 3 and state_1 to state_3 to 0. Then calls advance_sequence_checked.

name: call_state_2_handler_268c_unless_paused
what the code shows: Unless a pause flag is set, it calls the handler in handlers_268c indexed by state_2. Then it always calls func_8011ffdc.

name: advance_state_2_flip_facing_side
what the code shows: Sets sequence_changed_flag to 1, increments state_2, toggles facing_side, calls func_801380f0, ORs 0x200 into countdown, and calls advance_sequence_checked.

name: tick_countdown_then_reverse_x_motion
what the code shows: Subtracts 0x100 from the 16-bit countdown. When its high byte is zero, sets active_count to 1, state_0 to 1, other states to 0, vel_y to 0, and negates vel_x and accel_x. Then calls advance_sequence_checked.

name: call_handler_2694_by_state_2
what the code shows: Unless a pause flag is set, it calls the handler in handlers_2694 indexed by state_2. Then it always calls func_8011ffdc.

name: flip_facing_set_variant_and_advance

name: tick_countdown_and_reverse_x_motion
what the code shows: Subtracts 0x100 from the 16-bit countdown. If it goes negative, sets active_count 1, state_0 1, other states 0, negates vel_x and accel_x, and loads vel_y from table_269c indexed by vel_table_index>>1. Then calls advance_sequence_checked.

name: set_sequence_by_sound_side

name: call_kind_9_handler_for_player

name: reset_block_and_push_to_pool_table

name: update_units

name: init_counters_from_index_table

name: check_hit_of_a_wide_box_against_b_boxes

name: hit_response_by_flags
what the code shows: Calls func_8013a050 if a0->field_4b is nonzero, or by mode_id and active_state conditions with a2->hit_flags bit 7 clear; otherwise calls func_8013a154.

name: dispatch_hit_handler_by_box_type

name: set_hit_type_3_with_box_check

If data_80188ed0.in_04 is greater than in_00 calls set_hit_type_from_box_type_with_counter; otherwise sets a1->hit_type to 1.

name: hit_response_by_box_type_4

name: drain_gauge

name: update_gauge_from_pressed_bits

name: try_set_direction_from_pressed_bits

name: set_dir_match_flag

name: match_pressed_direction_input

Otherwise copies saved_facing, calls func_8013054c and, if its first byte equals direction_index, stores input_dir fields, calls func_80142c04, sets input_matched_flag and returns 1.

name: is_object_free_for_action
what the code shows: Returns 1 if field_7e is nonzero, field_163 is 0, health is not negative, active_state is 0, mode_flag_b, mode_flag_c and mode_flag_a are all 0, and func_8012f56c(object) returns 0. Otherwise it returns 0.

name: try_action_clearing_one_flag
what the code shows: Clears the flag at data_80190464. If the first four state bytes equal 0x20101 returns func_80141a00(object); otherwise sets the flag to 1, returns 0 if active_state is nonzero, else returns func_80141908(object).

name: try_action_unless_state_bytes_match

name: try_action_if_state_allows

name: try_start_effect_request

name: try_spend_meter_for_action
what the code shows: Returns 0 unless meter is at least 0x30, state is 0x101, hit_type is 0xff, no active_state, no mode flags, countdown below 8 and the other object is not in state 0x601. Then it subtracts 0x30 via func_80141f28, sets effect_request 4, calls other helpers and returns 1.

name: is_state_01010101_and_ready
what the code shows: Returns 1 when state_0..3 equal 0x1010101, active_state is nonzero, field_163 is zero, health is non-negative, config mode flags are zero and func_8012f56c returns 0; otherwise 0.

name: try_start_effect_by_state
what the code shows: Returns 0 unless state matches 0x20101 or a state_0/state_2 idle condition holds; also returns 0 if mode flags or func_8012f56c block it. Otherwise clears counters, possibly sets effect_request and plays a sound, copies field_25c to field_4b, calls func_80142c04 and returns 1.

name: is_not_state_2_five
what the code shows: If the 16-bit word of state_0/state_1 equals 1 returns whether state_2 is not 5; otherwise returns 1.

name: set_position_from_other_box
what the code shows: Sets ref_other.p to object->other and picks a box table by object->side and the other's kind. It indexes it by the frame's field_0b. It sets object->pos_x to the other's pos_x minus the box origin, negated if field_0b is set, and pos_y to the other's pos_y plus the box's field_02.

name: add_to_meter_clamped
what the code shows: Adds delta to object->field_c6, with early returns on several conditions: field_74, field_2a2, game_state.field_47, and a zero delta. A positive delta is quartered when field_d8 is set. The result is clamped to 0 and to 0x30 or 0x90. It calls play_sound_at with 0x325 when the value changes and reaches 0x90 or more.

name: select_direction_from_distance_table
what the code shows: Computes the abs vertical distance to ref_other.p and column from compare_limit+0x10; returns 0 if out of range or if the looked-up cell in table_8017ac54 has bit 0x80. Otherwise copies four bytes from table_8017ac7c into input_dir_0, input_dir_second, direction_index and attack_param_d and returns 1.

name: find_active_wide_box_and_check_other
what the code shows: Sets game_state.other_object from object->other and returns 0 unless its second word's low 24 bits equal 0x50001. Walks its sequence summing durations until a step whose frame has nonzero active, then returns func_80142424 with the wide_boxes offset by active and the elapsed time. Returns 0 if a negative-flag step is reached first.

name: select_inputs_from_threshold_mask
what the code shows: Builds a mask of reached thresholds, then clears the bits below the target position. It scans 12 entries from the top, shifting the mask by a table value chosen by the other object's input_dir_0. On a nonzero mask it copies four values from quad_table into the object's input_dir_0, input_dir_second, direction_index and attack_param_d, and returns 1. It returns nothing otherwise.

name: build_mask_of_reached_thresholds
what the code shows: Picks metrics_right or metrics_left by side and, for 12 pair entries, sets bit i of the returned mask when value is not less than the entry's first value. The mask is never initialised.

name: clear_mask_bits_below_target_position
what the code shows: Computes a target x from other_object's metrics row and pos_x, then for each of 12 bits set in mask, clears the bit if the position from pair_ptr delta and object pos_x is less than the target. Advances pair_ptr; returns nothing meaningful.

name: set_direction_index_from_buttons_mask_a

name: set_direction_index_from_buttons_mask_b
what the code shows: If field_4b is nonzero, it calls func_80142940. Otherwise it stores pressed_bits in game_state.field_354, then stores (pressed_bits | released_bits) & 0x6a there, and calls set_direction_index_from_meter_limit.

name: set_direction_index_from_meter_limit
what the code shows: Sets a limit of 4, 2 or 0 from game_state.field_354 value, caps it by a level (0, 2, 4) derived from object->meter thresholds 0x60 and 0x90, stores it in direction_index and field_255, then calls func_80142c04.

name: update_meter_by_mode_or_table

name: set_direction_index_four_then_update_meter

name: reset_hold_flags_and_other_hit_count

name: init_object_after_hit_and_spawn_three_effects

name: set_other_sequence_3_when_close

name: move_by_velocity_until_countdown_state_2

name: init_move_left_from_right_sequence_c

name: move_until_countdown_set_pos_play_sound

name: call_handler_by_state_2_b5f4_and_advance

name: init_slide_in_from_left_sequence_8

name: move_by_velocity_then_snap_pos_x

name: advance_state_2_on_step_flag_with_sound_b

name: finish_sequence_choose_next_with_sound
what the code shows: When step_flags is negative: if config->table_index is nonzero calls func_8014448c. Otherwise plays sound 0x208 or 0x209 (by mode_flag_2 of config->object_ptr), then calls func_80144090 if func_801441c8 is true, else func_80144e90.

name: set_state_2_7_and_sequence_d
what the code shows: Sets state_2 to 7 and calls func_80144ee4 with 0xd.

name: advance_state_2_on_step_flag_with_sound_c

name: send_cd_command_0d_set_state_five
